title: Short Form Video Editor
description: A company in the South Asian luxury fashion industry is looking for a creative and story-driven short-form video editor to join the team. This is a remote, part-time role working closely with a NYC-based founder and designer. If you have a strong creative instinct, a cinematic eye, and a deep understanding of what makes short-form content stop a scroll, we want to hear from you. This is not a generic influencer editing role. We are looking for someone who understands pacing, emotion, sound, and framing, and who can transform simple, low-fi footage into something that feels elevated and intentional. The aesthetic we are going for is cinematic, feminine, whimsical, emotional, and occasionally intense. Think the contrast between calm visuals and sharp pacing, between ordinary footage and unexpected creative decisions, between chaos and sudden stillness. Creative instinct matters more than technical complexity here. RESPONSIBILITIES - Edit 3 to 4 short-form videos per week optimized for TikTok and similar platforms - Create cinematic, Gen Z-style edits that prioritize storytelling over polish - Apply creative typography, framing, zooms, transitions, and pacing to elevate footage - Build strong sound design using music, silence, effects, and precise audio cuts - Source additional footage when needed to complete the story - Make independent creative decisions that enhance the narrative rather than follow a template - Work directly with scripts, voiceovers, and music provided to you - Handle all aspects of the edit including text, colour, framing, and pacing QUALIFICATIONS - Proven experience editing short-form video content, particularly for TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts - A portfolio that demonstrates strong storytelling, pacing, and aesthetic sensibility - Ability to work with simple, unpolished iPhone footage and elevate it through editing choices - Strong understanding of sound design and how audio shapes emotion and rhythm - Familiarity with the Gen Z / TikTok visual language without defaulting to generic trends - Ability to take creative ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do - Experience in fashion, lifestyle, or luxury content is a strong plus - Comfortable working remotely and independently on a consistent weekly schedule - Reliable communication and ability to meet turnaround expectations WHAT WE PROVIDE - Scripts and voiceover - Music selections - Most of the primary footage You will handle everything from there, including editing, sound design, text, framing, colour grading, pacing, and sourcing any additional footage needed. SCHEDULE - Remote position - 12 to 16 hours per week - CST schedule - Long-term opportunity - Starting soon HOW TO APPLY Please submit the following: - Updated Resume - Introduction Audio (Vacaroo is fine) - Updated Portfolio Note: This role requires a specific aesthetic sensibility. Please make sure your portfolio reflects cinematic, story-driven, or emotionally expressive work. Generic or template-based edits will not be considered.

title: Social Media Content Poster & Community Engager
job_title: Social Media Content Poster & Community Engager
description: We are looking for reliable social media posters to help manage and grow our brand presence across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and Snapchat using content we provide. This is a simple, flexible remote job — perfect for someone who wants steady part-time income with performance bonuses. What you'll do: Use your existing Facebook account, and create new accounts on Instagram, TikTok, and Snapchat — each dedicated to posting our content and clearly identifiable as a promo/affiliate/fan account for our brand (e.g. include our brand name or a variation in your bio/handle). Post provided content 2x per day on each platform (content is shared with you via a Telegram group). Engage with your audience and other accounts related to our niche (likes, comments, follows) to help grow each account. Keep a simple weekly note of follower growth and engagement per platform so we can track progress together. What we offer: Fixed monthly pay: $30/account — $120/month total for all 4 platforms Consistency bonus: +$20/month for posting reliably 2x/day on all accounts with no missed days Additional performance bonuses for any account that goes viral or hits engagement milestones Simple, fast tasks — a few minutes per day per platform Long-term opportunity for reliable posters Requirements: An existing Facebook account Willingness to create new accounts on Instagram, TikTok, and Snapchat Reliable internet access and smartphone No prior account restrictions/bans on your device Available to post consistently, 2x/day on each platform Access to Telegram (content will be shared there) How to apply: Send us a message and tell us which phone you have & when you'd be ready to start.

title: Video Editor + Graphic Designer (AI-Fluent) — Remote, Full-Time
job_title: Video Editor + Graphic Designer (AI-Fluent) — Remote, Full-Time
description: Hi, we're Real Mad Honey. We sell rare honey from the Himalayas and Turkey that actually does something you can feel. Our Meta ads run across the US, UK and EU, and we're scaling hard in 2026. That means we need more creative, faster, without the quality dropping. That's where you come in. Who you'll work with: You'll be reporting directly to our Creative Strategist. They own the creative direction, the briefs, the angles, the hooks, and the testing roadmap. Your job is to take their briefs and turn them into finished ads and assets. You'll have a clear brief for every piece of work, regular feedback loops, and a direct line to ask questions when something isn't clear. If you've worked in a setup where the strategist and the editor push each other to make the work sharper, you'll feel at home. What you'll actually be doing day to day: Most of your week is editing ad videos. Think UGC creators filming selfie-style, vox pop / street interview footage , and VSL-style longer explainer videos. The Creative Strategist will hand you raw footage, scripts and briefs. You turn it into scroll-stopping ads with clean subtitles, good pacing, sound design that doesn't overwhelm, and hooks that earn the first three seconds. On top of that, you'll design statics. Ad statics first, then occasional website visuals and landing page sections. Figma is our tool. If you already think in components and design tokens, even better. You'll also build organic assets for our social channels. Reels edits, carousel posts, story templates. The organic stuff doesn't have to sell, it has to feel like the brand. The AI part is not optional: Honestly, this is the thing that separates the editors we want from the ones we don't. We use AI throughout the workflow. Claude for scripting, copy, ideation, briefing. AI tools for transcription, subtitle generation, rough cuts, upscaling, voice cleanup, background removal, thumbnail variants, image generation for moodboards and concepts. If you can cut a 30-second UGC ad in 45 minutes instead of 3 hours because you know which AI tools to stack, you'll do great here. If AI tools scare you or you're still doing everything manually in 2026, this role will frustrate you. The systems we use: Trello for task management and deliverable tracking. Claude AI for briefs, scripts, brainstorms, copy. Figma for design. For editing, we work in the Adobe suite (Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator), so strong Adobe skills are important. If you also use CapCut Pro or DaVinci for certain cuts, that's fine as long as the output is clean and deliverables come back in the right format. Google Drive for asset handoff. What we need from you as a person: Communication is honestly half the job. If a deadline is going to slip, we want to know on day one, not day four. If a brief from the strategist is unclear, ask. If you think the script is weak, say so. We'd rather push back on a brief than receive a polished ad that misses. You'll be writing Trello updates, commenting on review links, jumping on the occasional Loom with the Creative Strategist, and responding to Slack-style messages during overlap hours. You don't need perfect English but you need to be clear, direct, and reliable. "Done by Friday" has to mean done by Friday. Who this role is for: Someone who's been editing performance ads for DTC brands for at least 2 to 3 years. You've seen UGC. You've seen vox pop. You've cut VSLs. You understand that an ad is not a film, it's a sales pitch with 3 seconds to land. You're fluent in Adobe Premiere and ideally comfortable in After Effects for motion graphics and text animations. You've used Figma seriously, not just opened it once. You've integrated AI into your pipeline because you care about speed without losing taste. Who this role is not for: Editors who take three days to turn around a simple ad cut. People who wait to be told exactly what to do. Designers who make beautiful work that doesn't convert. Anyone who needs hand-holding on Trello tickets or forgets to respond for two days. The work schedule Full-time, 40 hours per week. We're based in Europe so ideally you can overlap 3 to 4 hours with CET working hours. The rest is async. How to apply: Send us three things. - First, your portfolio. We want to see ad videos you've edited (UGC, vox pop, VSL if you have them) and static ads you've designed. If it's behind a password, include it. - Second, a short Loom (2 to 4 minutes) where you walk us through one ad you're proud of. Tell us why you made the choices you made. We care more about your thinking than your reel. -Third, tell us which AI tools you actually use in your workflow and what you use them for. One paragraph is fine. If you just say "ChatGPT" we'll know. Looking forward to seeing your work.

title: Ecommerce Video Editor — AI Ads / Direct Response
job_title: Ecommerce Video Editor — AI Ads / Direct Response
description: I run multiple ecommerce brands and I’m looking for an experienced video editor to join my creative team long-term. You must already have experience creating ecommerce ads. If your background is mainly weddings, travel videos, cinematic brand films, or general editing, this role is probably not a fit. Compensation: $480/month Location: Remote Position: Long-term What You’ll Do You’ll create short-form ads for: Meta / Facebook Instagram Reels TikTok You should be comfortable with: Ecommerce and direct-response editing Strong hooks and fast-paced ads AI UGC Turning images into realistic video Creating AI B-roll and product scenes Combining AI footage with real assets Understanding why an ad works Producing new creatives consistently AI Experience You should already use tools like Higgsfield, Kie.ai, or similar AI platforms. I’m looking for someone who can use AI to create realistic UGC, product demonstrations, B-roll, visual hooks, and ad variations — not just generate clips and add text. You should also be able to work independently without needing detailed instructions for every cut. How to Apply Start your application with: AI-GURU Then send: 1. Ecommerce experience Tell me which ecommerce brands or stores you’ve created ads for. 2. Your best work Send 3–5 ads you personally edited. AI UGC and direct-response ads are preferred. 3. Your AI workflow In 1–2 sentences, tell me which AI tools you use and what you use them for. Paid Trial If your portfolio is a good fit, I’ll send you a product, brief, and assets to create approximately 1 minute of ad creative. The trial is paid if you are selected. If everything works well, I’m looking for someone who can work with me consistently for the long term.

title: Ecommerce Funnel Builder | Funnelish and Shopify
job_title: Ecommerce Funnel Builder | Funnelish and Shopify
description: Please read the complete post before applying. This role is for an experienced ecommerce Funnel Builder who can handle both page execution and technical setup. It is not an entry-level design position. Capital Heaven operates health, beauty, wellness and personal-care ecommerce brands across several international markets. We need someone who can take an approved source funnel, rebuild or localize it accurately, connect the correct products and offers, test the full customer journey and deliver it ready for launch. You should be comfortable working independently from a written task while communicating clearly when information is missing or a technical issue could delay the launch. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES - Build, duplicate and localize ecommerce funnels in Funnelish. - Create and update advertorials, sales pages, checkout pages, upsells and other required funnel steps. - Review the complete task before starting and confirm the correct product, source funnel, store, market, language, currency, offer and deadline. - Preserve the approved structure, angle and customer journey unless different instructions are provided. - Update all market-specific copy, currencies, units, names, images, buttons, disclaimers and footer details. - Create and configure Shopify products, variants, quantities, images, pricing, compare-at pricing, SKUs and URL paths. - Connect every button and bundle option to the correct Shopify product and variant. - Set up and check AfterSell flows when required. - Configure domains, redirects, pixels, tracking and required events according to the company SOP. - Work with WeTracked or similar ecommerce tracking tools. - Test the full funnel on desktop and mobile, including page flow, buttons, bundles, shipping, checkout, payment options and tracking. - Correct failed checks and retest the affected journey before submitting the funnel. - Provide clear completion updates in ClickUp and Slack with live links, screenshots, test results and any remaining blockers. - Coordinate with the product research, creative, media buying and Meta asset teams during handoffs. - Stop and escalate when instructions conflict or when a product, offer, checkout path, domain or tracking setup cannot be verified. REQUIRED EXPERIENCE - Strong professional experience building ecommerce or dropshipping funnels. - Hands-on experience using Funnelish for advertorials, sales pages, checkouts and upsells. - Practical Shopify experience, including products, variants, pricing, SKUs, bundle connections and checkout paths. - Experience duplicating or localizing proven funnels for different stores, countries, languages and currencies. - Strong understanding of responsive design and mobile funnel testing. - Ability to troubleshoot broken buttons, incorrect variants, checkout problems, domain issues, redirects and tracking errors. - Experience with Meta Pixel, events and ecommerce tracking tools. - Strong attention to product codes, prices, offers, currencies, markets and technical details. - Ability to follow SOPs and detailed written instructions without skipping QA steps. - Clear written English and reliable communication through Slack and ClickUp. - Ability to manage several assigned funnels and meet deadlines without sacrificing accuracy. - Full-time and long-term availability. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE - Experience with AfterSell, WeTracked, Meta Pixel, Google Sheets and Google Drive. - Experience with health, beauty, wellness, supplement or personal-care products. - Familiarity with direct-response advertorials, bundles, upsells and conversion-focused page structures. - Experience supporting several ecommerce stores and international markets. - Previous experience training or reviewing other funnel builders. QUALITY AND COMPLIANCE Accuracy is more important than rushing a funnel live. You must request clarification when the approved source, product, store, market, language, currency, price, offer, shipping, checkout, tracking or deadline is missing or conflicting. You must also flag unsupported medical claims, guaranteed results, misleading before-and-after content, unapproved testimonials or endorsements, excessive discounts, wrong-market references and incorrect technical routing. Never edit a live winning source funnel directly. Do not place a real order during testing. GROWTH OPPORTUNITY This opening is for a Funnel Builder. A highly experienced employee who consistently demonstrates strong technical ability, ownership, quality control and leadership may later be trained for a Funnel Manager position. WHAT WE OFFER - A stable, long-term remote position. - Full-time work across several ecommerce brands and markets. - Clear SOPs, checklists and task-based workflows. - Exposure to funnel production, localization, checkout setup, tracking and launch coordination. - Compensation based on demonstrated experience and skill level. - A possible future growth path for someone who performs consistently and can support the wider funnel team. HOW TO APPLY Begin your application with the word FUNNEL to confirm that you read the complete post. Answer all questions below. Give specific examples instead of general statements. 1. How many years of professional funnel-building experience do you have, and how much of that work was for ecommerce or dropshipping brands? 2. Describe your hands-on Funnelish experience. Which funnel pages and technical setups have you completed yourself? 3. Describe your Shopify experience with products, variants, quantities, SKUs, pricing, checkout links and bundles. 4. Share two or three live, recorded or redacted examples of funnels you personally built. Explain exactly which parts you completed. 5. What experience do you have with AfterSell, WeTracked, Meta Pixel, events or other tracking systems? 9. How many complete funnels can you normally deliver per week while maintaining reliable desktop and mobile QA? 10. Have you trained or reviewed other funnel builders? If yes, briefly explain your experience. 11. Are you available full-time and long-term, and what is your earliest possible start date? 12. What is your expected monthly salary in USD? description: # WordPress Content & SEO Specialist – Remote We are looking for a reliable and detail-oriented **WordPress Content & SEO Specialist** from the Philippines to help us improve and update an established travel website about Málaga, Costa del Sol and Andalusia in Spain. This is not a new website. The website already contains approximately **400 English pages**, and our goal is to systematically refresh, improve and optimise the existing content. In a later phase, the same website structure will also be expanded and optimised in **German, Spanish and Japanese**, resulting in a large long-term project with more than 1,500 pages. ## Main Responsibilities Your main task will be to update and improve existing WordPress pages using **ChatGPT and Rank Math SEO**. Typical tasks include: * Refresh and improve existing website content * Rewrite outdated or weak sections using ChatGPT * Improve readability and content structure * Add or improve headings such as H2 and H3 * Improve introductions and conclusions * Add useful FAQ sections where appropriate * Improve internal linking between related pages * Check existing links and identify broken or outdated links * Add relevant external links to authoritative sources when useful * Improve image ALT text * Improve meta titles and meta descriptions * Optimise pages using Rank Math SEO * Select and use appropriate focus keywords * Improve keyword placement without keyword stuffing * Improve Rank Math SEO scores * Improve structured content for Google and AI search engines * Review existing content for outdated information * Correct formatting problems inside WordPress * Follow our existing page templates and website structure You will mainly work on **existing pages**, not create completely new websites. ## Tools You Will Use You should already be comfortable working with: * WordPress * Rank Math SEO * ChatGPT * Google Search * Google Search Console * Basic keyword research tools Experience with the following is an advantage: * Bricks Builder * Advanced Custom Fields / ACF * Local SEO * Schema markup * Google Analytics * AI-assisted content optimisation * multilingual WordPress websites ## Important: How We Use ChatGPT We actively use ChatGPT to improve and update content. However, we do NOT want somebody who simply copies and pastes AI-generated text. You must be able to: * give ChatGPT good instructions * evaluate AI-generated content * correct inaccurate information * remove unnecessary or repetitive text * verify important facts * keep the content natural and useful for real travellers * maintain a consistent writing style throughout the website The objective is **better content**, not simply more content. ## About the Website The website is an established travel guide focusing on: * Málaga * Costa del Sol * Axarquía * Andalusia * attractions * beaches * restaurants * events * villages * activities * local travel information Approximately **400 English pages** currently need to be reviewed and improved. After the English version has been completed, we plan to work on: * German * Spanish * Japanese This means there is substantial potential for **long-term cooperation**. ## What We Are Looking For You should have: * very good written English * solid WordPress experience * practical Rank Math SEO experience * good understanding of on-page SEO * experience using ChatGPT professionally * strong attention to detail * ability to follow detailed instructions * ability to work independently * ability to work systematically through a large number of pages * good research skills * reliable communication You do NOT need to be a programmer. This position is primarily about **content optimisation, WordPress and SEO**. ## Very Important We are looking for someone who works carefully and consistently. We prefer quality over speed. We do not want: * automatically generated low-quality AI content * keyword stuffing * generic SEO text * mass-produced articles without fact checking * unnecessary rewriting of good existing content * black-hat SEO * automated backlink building Many of the existing pages already contain valuable original information. Your job is to **improve what already exists**, not replace everything. ## Working Arrangement * Remote position * Philippines-based applicants preferred * Long-term project * Initial focus: approximately 400 English pages * Additional languages and pages later * Flexible working hours possible * Part-time depending on experience and availability We will initially start with a small number of pages to evaluate the quality of your work. If the cooperation works well, there is enough work available for a long-term position. ## How to Apply Please include the following in your application: 1. Your experience with WordPress 2. Your experience with Rank Math SEO 3. How you currently use ChatGPT for SEO or content optimisation 4. Examples of WordPress websites or SEO projects you have worked on 5. Your expected hourly rate or monthly salary 6. How many hours per week you are available 7. Your internet connection and normal working hours 8. Whether you have experience with travel websites or local SEO Please also answer this question: **If you were given an existing 1,500-word WordPress travel page with a Rank Math score of 55/100, what would be the first five things you would check before changing the content?** Applications that do not answer this question may not be considered. ### Please note We are looking for a person who wants to understand the website and improve it over time — not someone who simply runs pages through ChatGPT and publishes the result.

title: Creative Strategist – DTC & Meta Paid Social
job_title: Creative Strategist – DTC & Meta Paid Social
description: About the Role This is a strategy-first role. You will own the creative thinking for two to three DTC accounts — the desires we go after, the avatars we speak to, the angles we test, the concepts that carry them, and the briefs that get them made. You do not edit video, design statics, or buy media. You will occasionally build reference frames so an editor can see what you mean, but execution is not your job. D ---------- what gets made, and why, is. Most of the work sits in health, wellness, and supplements, with room to expand into other e-commerce categories. It is a crowded, compliance-tight space where the gap between a winning ad and a dead one is almost always the angle, not the production quality. Work Structure & Requirements Schedule: Central European Time Compensation: 8 USD per hour **negotiable Key Responsibilities 1. Creative Strategy Start from the desire the product actually serves, not the feature list Identify the core avatar and sub-avatars underneath it, defined by what they have already tried and why it failed them Turn those into testable angles, then into concepts, then into briefs — three different things, and you brief all three Maintain a pipeline across angles, formats, hooks, and offers, with a stated reason for every test Balance net-new concepts against iterations of proven winners 2. Brief Writing Produce 5–15 briefs per client per week depending on scope, across short-form video, UGC, statics, and native-style formats Every brief ships ready to execute: hook and opening concept, core message, script or talking points, visual direction, CTA, required assets, and editing notes Write scripts yourself — an editor should never have to come back and ask what you meant 3. Research Mine Amazon reviews (positive and negative) for the words customers actually use Use Google searches to find what the market is confused about Analyze Meta Ad Library and other ad libraries — what competitors are running, how long it has been live, and the technique underneath it rather than the line itself Review competitor sites, offers, pricing, and landing pages Pull voice of customer from Reddit, YouTube comments, ad comments, support tickets, and forums — their own sentence reads as recognition; a paraphrased problem reads as marketing Identify what the market has already been told and already tried, so you stop repeating a claim it stopped believing 4. Performance Review & Recommendations Come to performance reviews having already asked for the data you need — chasing the right numbers is part of the role Diagnose why something won or lost specifically: was it the angle or the execution? Recommend what to kill, what to iterate, and what to leave running — with the reasoning behind each call Feed learnings directly into the next round of briefs 5. AI Integration Use AI as part of your workflow for research, synthesis, ideation support, reference frames, and speeding up mechanical parts of the job Hooks, angles, and scripts come from you — not AI Required Skills & Experience Experience: 3+ years personally owning creative strategy for DTC paid social — in-house or agency; owning it, not contributing to it Performance Mindset: You judge creative on hook rate, hold rate, CTR, and CPA/ROAS against a target — not on whether it looks good Conceptual Clarity: You can explain the difference between a desire, an avatar, an angle, a concept, and a hook without hedging Copywriting: Excellent written English and real copywriting ability — the hook is the job; you write UGC scripts yourself and brief editors and creators directly Awareness Levels: You write for different levels of awareness and know why a hook that lands on someone already shopping falls flat on someone who hasn't named the problem yet Iteration: You iterate deliberately — you know what to change in a winner and what to leave alone Compliance: Comfortable inside a compliance-tight category; health and supplement claims live within real limits and you write inside them by instinct Organization: Organized enough to carry two to three brands at once without dropping a deadline Bonus: Agency experience, worked directly alongside Meta media buyers, experience with advertorials, VSLs, and long-form direct response To Apply: Kindly send your resume, introduction video and portfolio

title: Senior Creator Sourcing Specialist
description: PLEASE APPLY DIRECTLY ON THIS LINK: Job Title:Senior Creator Sourcing Specialist Location: Fully Remote Commitment: Full time (operating in UK/EU hours) Reports to: Head of Creator Team Salary Range: Salary is dependent on experience Company: Adcrate Ltd About Adcrate: Adcrate is a fast-growing, AI-driven performance marketing agency helping eCommerce and digital product brands scale through creative that converts and paid media that performs. We combine data, testing, and bold ideas to drive real growth for our clients. We’re a fully remote team of strategists, video editors, and performance experts spread across the globe - agile, ambitious, and always experimenting. We move fast, stay curious, and genuinely care about doing great work. The Role: As a Senior Creator Sourcing Specialist, you'll take ownership of creator sourcing across a portfolio of eCommerce brands - from understanding what each brand needs and finding the right creators, through to outreach, selection and getting creators agreed and ready to move into production. This isn't just about sourcing names. We're looking for someone who understands what makes a great creator for a brand, can confidently work alongside our Creative Strategists to recommend the right talent, and can independently own the sourcing process across multiple brands at once. Once a creator has been selected and their agreement is in place, you'll typically complete a clear handover into Creator Communications, who will manage the creator relationship throughout briefing, filming, footage and delivery. There may also be occasions where you'll continue to own the creator journey through to completion, depending on the brand, project or needs of the team. What you'll be doing: - Owning creator sourcing across your portfolio of eCommerce brands - Understanding individual brand requirements, audiences and creative direction before beginning sourcing - Proactively sourcing creators who fit each brand's audience, content style and campaign requirements - Reviewing and assessing potential creators to make sure we're putting forward strong, relevant options rather than simply hitting volume - Presenting creator recommendations to Creative Strategists and working closely with them to make final selections - Managing initial creator outreach and communication throughout the sourcing and selection process - Confirming creator interest, availability, rates and relevant requirements before progressing - Managing the creator process through to selection and agreement - Completing a clear handover into Creator Communications once the creator agreement is in place - Maintaining and continuously building our Creator Pool so the wider team has access to a strong network of relevant, reliable creators - Identifying creators we've had a great experience with and opportunities to work with them again - Keeping sourcing requests, creator information and internal tracking accurate and up to date - Managing multiple brands and sourcing requests at once while keeping on top of priorities and deadlines - Spotting difficult to source briefs, delays or potential blockers early and proactively finding solutions - Working closely with Creative Strategists and the wider Creator team to continually improve the quality and efficiency of sourcing - Where required, owning the wider creator journey beyond sourcing, including briefing, coordination and delivery What we're looking for: - You have 1+ years of experience in creator sourcing, influencer marketing, UGC, creator partnerships or a similar role - You have experience owning creator campaigns/processes from sourcing through to delivery, rather than only one part of the journey - You have a strong eye for creator quality and understand how to match the right creator, audience and content style to a brand - You're confident sourcing and reaching out to creators across different platforms and markets - You're comfortable managing multiple brands, creators and deadlines at once without things slipping through the cracks - You communicate clearly and confidently with creators and internal teams - You're proactive - if something is delayed, unclear or isn't working, you're comfortable taking ownership and finding a solution - You understand UGC and performance-led creative, or you're excited to deepen your knowledge in this space - You're organised, detail-orientated and comfortable working independently in a fast-moving remote environment - You're someone who naturally takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what happens next What Success Looks Like: - Creator requests are consistently delivered on time with no gaps or delays - Minimal need for follow-ups or chasing - Clear, accurate communication with creators across all briefs - Strong creator matches aligned to briefs and brand needs - Proactive handling of requests (nothing stalls or gets dropped) - Consistent, reliable delivery across multiple briefs without oversight - Head of Creator Team is no longer pulled into day to day coordination or fixing issues Team Interaction: 💬 Slack: is where everything happens. Whether it's client wins, creative feedback, questions, memes, gifs, or sharing what you're up to at the weekend, it's the heart of our remote team. 📞 Weekly Calls & Creative Training: We hold weekly team check-ins, creative reviews and training sessions to keep everyone connected and continuously learning. It's a chance to bounce ideas around, challenge thinking and sharpen your creative skills. Calls are typically held between 2pm-6pm GMT on Mondays and Wednesdays. ✈️ Retreats & Team Socials: We're a remote-first business, but we love getting together in person too. Every year we bring the team together to celebrate wins, reflect on progress and have some fun. So far, we've taken the team to Thailand, with Summer and Winter Socials, team meet-ups and retreats continuing to be a big part of our culture. 📈 Growth & Development: We're big believers that growth doesn't stop once you're hired. Whether it's learning from the team around you, joining creative training sessions, taking on new challenges or developing your leadership skills, we'll support you in growing both personally and professionally. 🎉 Culture: Building a strong remote culture is incredibly important to us. From Quarterly Games Days and team lunches to wellness sessions, challenges and virtual events, we're always looking for new ways to bring the team together and make Adcrate a fun place to work.

title: AI Video Editor
description: We are looking for someone who combines technical AI skills with strong video editing and sound design. The role has two parts: setting up an LTX video-generation system, either locally or on rented GPU servers, and using it alongside conventional editing to create engaging children’s YouTube videos. We want someone who can turn photos, illustrations, narration and music into polished videos that feel alive, rather than basic slideshows. You need to be comfortable with both the technical setup and the creative production. Experience using online AI generators alone is not sufficient. 1. Set up our LTX video-generation system Review our existing hardware and requirements, then recommend whether we should run LTX locally or through rented GPU servers. Explain the likely costs, performance, limitations and ease of use before we agree on an approach. Once agreed, you will install and configure LTX, the necessary dependencies and a suitable interface such as ComfyUI. We only need the chosen solution implemented, not both local and cloud systems. Create a reusable image-to-video workflow that allows us to upload an image, enter a prompt, adjust the main settings and generate a clip. Test the system with our supplied images, troubleshoot problems and demonstrate the actual generation times and output quality. We need realistic expectations, including the cost and time involved in unsuccessful generations and retries. Cost control is important. For rented servers, explain all ongoing charges, configure appropriate idle or shutdown controls where supported, and clearly document how to stop the system and which charges may continue. No spending or recurring commitments should be activated without approval. Provide the workflow files, setup documentation and a short recorded walkthrough so another team member can operate the system. Accounts and installations must remain under our control. 2. Create visually engaging videos Use supplied scripts, narration, photos, illustrations, music and songs to create finished children’s story videos. Combine thoughtful editing with selective AI-generated animation. You should know when animation adds value and when a well-edited still image is the better choice. Use purposeful camera movements, pans, zooms, layered depth effects, reaction shots and well-timed cuts to support the storytelling. Maintain consistent character appearances and visual style, and reject generated footage with distracting distortions or unwanted changes. We want a warm, cinematic and imaginative feel, with pacing that holds children’s attention without relying on constant noise, excessive effects or frantic cutting. For song sequences, the visuals should follow the rhythm and emotional progression of the music. 3. Make the audio engaging and professional Sound quality is just as important as the visuals. Preserve the clarity and natural quality of the supplied narration and character voices. Balance dialogue, music, atmosphere and sound effects so speech remains easy to understand. Use appropriate environmental sounds and well-timed effects to bring scenes to life, without overwhelming the narration. Avoid unnecessary voice processing, distortion, abrupt volume changes or repetitive sound effects. We need someone who understands how sound supports storytelling, not simply someone who adds a music track underneath a video. Skills and experience You should have: Hands-on experience installing and troubleshooting LTX, together with experience of ComfyUI or a comparable workflow interface. The ability to assess local GPU hardware and rented GPU options, manage dependencies and resolve technical errors. Strong editing skills in DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro or equivalent software, including audio mixing and sound design. A portfolio demonstrating visual storytelling, particularly videos created from still images or illustrations. Clear English communication, organised project files and the ability to work independently while responding well to feedback. Experience with children’s content, illustrated stories, animation or music videos would be valuable. Deliverables For the setup, we expect a working, tested system, reusable workflows, clear operating instructions and a complete handover. For ongoing editing, we expect finished videos in the agreed format, editable project files and organised supporting assets. Use only authorised or appropriately licensed assets. Supplied voice recordings must not be used for voice cloning, model training or unrelated projects. How to apply Please include: Two or three relevant video examples. At least one should demonstrate how you made still images or illustrations engaging. Explain exactly which parts you created, including the audio work. Evidence of your LTX setup experience. Describe a system you personally installed, the hardware or hosting used, and a technical problem you solved. Screenshots or a short demonstration are welcome, with private information hidden. Your proposed approach. Briefly explain what you would need to assess local versus rented-server options. Your rates and availability. Quote the initial setup separately from your ongoing editing rate, and state your weekly availability. An indicative production timeframe. Estimate how long an 8–10-minute narrated story video would take when the main images, narration and music are supplied. Explain your assumptions. Please use “LTX Setup and Video Editor” as your application subject. Paid trial Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete a paid 45–60-second editing test using supplied images, narration and music. We will assess visual storytelling, pacing, sound design and preservation of voice quality. Technical experience will be assessed separately through a walkthrough of previous work, with the actual installation treated as an agreed paid milestone. We are looking for someone who can both build a reliable production system and use it to make excellent videos.

SHOW US YOUR WORK This is the part of the application we care about most. Please provide a small sample of at least 5 leads, showing the variety of retailers and products you typically look at in a day. This can be: OPTION A: Sample leads or a sample lead spreadsheet. Screenshots or a view-only Google Sheets link are welcome. Please remove or blur confidential information from previous employers. title: Amazon UK Product Sourcer (Online Arbitrage) - Experienced UK OA Sourcers Only
job_title: Amazon UK Product Sourcer (Online Arbitrage) - Experienced UK OA Sourcers Only
description: We are looking for an experienced Amazon Product Sourcer to help us grow and scale our UK Amazon FBA business. The main focus of the role is sourcing profitable products in the UK marketplace, primarily via Online Arbitrage. WE HAVE THE CAPITAL READY TO SPEND. WHAT WE NEED IS MORE HIGH-QUALITY LEADS. That is the whole job, and it is why we are only looking for proven UK OA sourcers this time. If you are new to sourcing or have only worked the US market, this role is not for you. WE ARE NOT LOOKING FOR THE SAME LEADS EVERYONE ELSE BUYS. Deal lists, ---------- feeds and the top page of the scanning tools are seen by hundreds of sellers on the same day and the margin is gone within hours. We want a sourcer who can MANUFACTURE THEIR OWN DISCOUNT (stacking codes, clearance, discounts and anything else to make profitable products, price matches, multi-buy and bundle offers, newsletter and app-only promotions) and who can FIND LOW-KEY LEADS that never appear on a shared list: quiet retailers, deep category pages, seasonal clearance, brands with no third-party sellers yet. If you can take a shelf price that shows 5% ROI and turn it into a 25% buy, you are who we want. The role includes an UNCAPPED BONUS based on the spend on leads you provide. The more we buy from your leads, the more you earn. Our top performing sourcers regularly earn an extra $400+ per month on top of salary, and there is no ceiling. FOR A PROVEN, ABSOLUTE TOP PERFORMER, THE BASE SALARY IS NEGOTIABLE. Show us your track record and we will talk. The ideal candidate is self-motivated, hungry, and looking for a long-term position with space to grow. We ask that only candidates with real experience of Online Arbitrage product sourcing in the UK marketplace apply. WHAT AN A-CLASS SOURCER LOOKS LIKE TO US: - Consistently delivers leads we actually buy, not long lists of borderline ones - Manufactures margin: knows every legitimate way to get a UK retailer's price down (code stacking, cashback sites, discounted gift cards, loyalty schemes, price matching, multi-buys, app and newsletter codes etc) and builds that into the lead before submitting it - Finds low-key leads through methods the shared tools and deal lists do not surface: manual retailer digging, storefront and reverse sourcing, deep category and clearance pages, brands with no third-party sellers, seasonal and regional stock - Uses a wide range of sourcing methods and keeps finding new ones (retailer clearance and promotions, brand and category scanning, Keepa Product Finder) - Reads a Keepa chart properly: real sales velocity, the real sell price, Buy Box behaviour, etc - Checks gating, IP risk, variations and VAT before submitting, so leads arrive clean - Knows UK retailers and discount routes that most sourcing VAs do not EXPERIENCE REQUESTED (please include details of your experience against each point in your application): - 12+ months experience in OA sourcing for the UK market specifically - Strong working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, SellerAmp SAS and Keepa - Experience in a variety of different sourcing methods for OA (and wholesale or Amazon-to-Amazon if applicable) - list every sourcing method you have used, step by step - Google Sheets / Excel - Understanding of UK VAT and UK FBA fees in profit calculations KEY RESPONSIBILITIES: - Product research and analysis in SAS and Keepa - Finding your own leads from UK retailers and suppliers using your full range of methods - Verifying, prioritising and re-checking leads passed to you by the team before they are bought - Inputting leads into our leads database in the required format, with your reasoning - Flagging replenishable winners WHAT WE OFFER: - $350 / month starting base salary + uncapped performance bonus paid on spend from your leads - Flexible working hours (40 hours per week, work when suits you, with at least a one hour crossover with UK 9am-5pm for communication) - Salary reviewed regularly and increased based on contribution and performance; base negotiable for a proven top performer - Career development: we are expanding our team of VAs and will be promoting internally for managers and purchasers - Long-term, stable role with a growing UK business REQUIREMENTS: - Full-time: 40 hours a week - You will use timeproof software to demonstrate you are working effectively during contracted hours - You will work for us and only us; you may not source for other e-commerce sellers at the same time - Every lead you submit is checked. Padded or copied lead sheets end the trial. - Include the words "BIG CHEESE" in your application subject. Applications without it are ignored. This is to make sure you have read the post. TO APPLY: Respond with the subject line above and include ALL of the following. Applications missing any of these are not read: 1. A brief description of why you are the best candidate and how you can help us grow. 2. Every sourcing method you use, step by step, in your own words. Which retailers, which discount and cashback routes, which Keepa filters, how you stack them. "I use Keepa and SAS" is not an answer. 3. How you manufacture discount. Give us a real example of a deal where the shelf price did not work and you built the margin yourself: which codes, cashback, gift card or loyalty discounts you stacked, in what order, and what the final buy price and ROI came to. Legitimate, publicly available discounts only. 4. 2-3 real UK product leads you have found in the last 7 days that did NOT come from a deal list, ---------- feed or the top page of a scanning tool: retailer purchase link, Amazon link, buy price including delivery and any discount applied, sell price, ROI, net profit after VAT and fees, estimated monthly sales, SAS and Keepa screenshots, how you found it, and a short description of why it is a good lead. This is mandatory, not optional, and it carries the most weight in our decision. Leads we recognise from public lists count against you. 5. Your track record: for your last one or two UK clients, roughly how much did they spend per month on your leads, and what ROI did those leads return? Do you have your old lead sheet for us to see example leads? If you have a CV, portfolio or anything else that demonstrates why we should hire you, include it. Shortlisted candidates get a short video call and a paid two-week trial working real leads.

title: Amazon Seller Central Account Manager - Listings, Deals & Catalog
job_title: Amazon Seller Central Account Manager - Listings, Deals & Catalog
description: Dear applicant, Thank you for your interest in our job assignment. We are looking for a dedicated Person who is willing to support our team in full time in the field of Amazon Account Management. After a phase of training and integration into our team and systems, you will be the person in charge for our product listings, prices and deals on the European Amazon marketplaces. You will make sure that every product is listed correctly, priced correctly and promoted at the right time. We are therefore looking for a person with an especially high sense for responsibility, high vigilance and detail orientation. Pre-knowledge is beneficial, but first and foremost you must be willing to learn about Amazon Account Management quickly. What you will be doing: • Maintaining and improving our product listings across all European marketplaces (titles, bullet points, descriptions, images, product data) • Keeping our variation families (parent/child) clean and complete, so customers always see the full product range on one page • Managing our prices and strike-through prices (UVP) per marketplace and watching the Buy Box • Planning and submitting our Amazon deals (Best Deals, Lightning Deals), checking that every deal price is correct and follows the European price rules • Watching running deals and reacting when Amazon suppresses or rejects one • Analysing customer returns and reviews to find product problems and report them to the team • Keeping our product compliance information correct and up to date • Communicating with Amazon Seller Support when listings or deals need to be fixed The skills you will need: • Perfect English in writing, speaking and understanding. • Good skills with computer, office programs, especially Excel • You are comfortable with numbers, percentages and simple calculations, because prices and discounts are a daily part of the job • Knowledge about E-Commerce, Amazon Seller Central and marketplace business is welcome, but not mandatory. It is most important that you are willing to learn. We can teach you all the important aspects of the job. We are looking for a person with the following personality traits and values: • Looking for long term employment • Highly motivated • Honest, reliable and transparent • High sense for responsibility • Vigilant and detail oriented • Structured and able to work through repeating tasks without losing accuracy • Learns from mistakes • Loves to improve and learn • Learns quickly What we can offer you: • Long term employment starting as soon as October 2026. • Help you to grow your skill set and knowledge about Amazon, E-Commerce and international business • Work with our own in-house software, which we build and improve together with the team • Be a part of a small but highly motivated team • Flexible working time and location • Fair salary with performance based raises • After established and proven work relationship, support with work setup improvement: Computer, Screen, Desk, Office Devices, Air conditioner etc. About our company: Our company has been founded 8 years ago in Lübeck, Germany and is mainly active in E-Commerce business. We sell tools and electrician equipment on Amazon and on our own online shop and we are the market leader in the niche. We are active on several European marketplaces with a large catalogue and many product variations, so there are a lot of listings, prices and deals to be managed. Our mission is to build a company that delivers great quality for fair prices to as many customers as possible, while at the same time providing a sustainably good work environment for our team. We are always looking to improve ourselves and to grow our business across Europe. The more we grow, the more challenges we will be facing. Therefore you should also be interested in always improving and change should not scare you. For this job, you will need a very good and reliable internet connection as well as a properly working computer, preferably a Macbook. If you are interested in becoming a member of our company team, we are looking forward to your application. Please make sure to include the following aspects and answer all the below questions in your application. All other applications that are not complete will be sorted out. • Make sure to include your CV • Do you already have a job? • Are you looking for a long term full time employment? • When would you like to start working? • Do you have your own highly reliable computer and internet access? • Have you worked with Amazon Seller Central or another online marketplace before? If yes, please describe what exactly you did. • Please write in detail in which way you match the required skills and personality traits. • Please include in the Subject of your application the phrase "BST ACCOUNT" so we know you have read this job post fully. If you believe you are a great fit, send us your application now! We are looking forward to hearing from you. Best regards, Anton Levkau Bodenständig Germany

title: Instagram Content Creator + Copywriter (Personal Brand / Online Business) — Proven Growth Required
job_title: Instagram Content Creator + Copywriter (Personal Brand / Online Business) — Proven Growth Required
description: ABOUT US AGENCY678 is a UK based sales and operations consultancy. We help online agency and service business owners fix their offer and install a proper sales system so they stop leaking revenue they've already earned. Our core offer is The Velocity System. It's for agency owners already doing consistent months who have stalled because their sales process is held together with good intentions, a messy CRM and a follow up that never happens. We fix the offer, install the system, and recover revenue already sitting in the business. We deliberately don't lead with paid ads. I'm Zoe, the founder. Ex corporate & online closer, six plus years in sales before I built this. I'm growing my personal brand on ---------- and we have aggressive targets for the rest of 2026. Instagram is the engine for that. THE ROLE You'll own the creation, copy and scheduling of my Instagram content, with a heavy focus on trial reels. Day to day: - Write copy: hooks, captions, story copy, carousel slides, DM scripts. This is a big part of the role, not an afterthought. You'll be given the strategy, the angles and the positioning, and you'll write from it - Create and schedule trial reels (we run a high volume batch cadence, roughly 5 reels a day) - Edit talking head video: trim, caption, text overlays, sync music, mute original audio where needed - Hold the brand visual standards (approved fonts only, text placed in the empty space in frame rather than dead centre, music over muted original audio) - Track what performs, flag the winners, and tell me what you think we should double down on - Bring ideas. I don't want an order taker. I want someone who watches the account and says "this angle is working, let's push it" WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR Must haves: - Strong copywriting. You can write hooks and captions that sound like a real person with a point of view, not like AI. This is the number one thing I'm hiring for alongside proven growth - Proven experience growing Instagram accounts, with numbers you can show me - Proven experience creating content that generates organic leads and enquiries, not just views - Confident editing talking head video for reels - You understand the online business, agency and coaching space. You know what an offer, a pipeline, a sales call and a close actually are, and you can write about them without sounding vague - Proactive, organised, and you follow a brief exactly. If I ask for the first 5 for review before you schedule the rest, that's what I need - Excellent written English Nice to have but not essential: Experience with trial reels specifically Experience writing for a founder or personal brand in the B2B or sales space What you do NOT need: You don't need to be a Canva wizard. I'm very happy for content to be created natively in the Instagram app. That's how I work and it suits the style of the account HOURS AND PAY Part time, 10 to 20 hours per week $10 to $20 USD per hour depending on experience and proven results Long term role for the right person, with scope to increase hours Some overlap with UK hours preferred, but I'm flexible HOW TO APPLY Applications without the below will not be read. Please send me: - Two or three Instagram accounts you have grown. Include the handle, how long you worked on it, follower count when you started and when you finished, and screenshots of the insights to back it up - Proof of ROI. Show me enquiries, DMs, call bookings or sales that came from content you made. Screenshots or numbers are fine - Three to five examples of reels you personally created and edited. Send links - Two examples of copy you have written. Captions, hooks, or a carousel. It must be your own writing, not AI Answer these three questions in your reply: - What makes a hook stop someone scrolling? Give me one example of a hook you have written that performed and tell me why it worked - What would you check first if a reel got high views but no enquiries? - Tell me about a time you spotted something in the content data and changed the approach off the back of it Start your application with the word VELOCITY so I know you've read the whole thing Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a paid test task (2 to 3 hours): I'll give you an angle plus some raw talking head footage. You'll write the hook and caption and create the finished reel to my brand standards. I'm looking for someone who genuinely wants to build something with me, not just tick off tasks. If that's you, I'd love to hear from you.

title: Head of Marketing
description: Empire Barbershop is AMBA’s #1 Barbershop of the Year for 2025. We’re a single location in Oakleigh becoming something considerably larger — a rebrand lands this quarter, a second site opens early next year, and the plan after that is not modest. Our core value is Service First. The whole client experience is the product, not just the cut. Our marketing has to be worthy of that, which frankly it currently isn’t. That’s the job. What you’ll own • Reactivation. Email and SMS campaigns across our Fresha database via Klaviyo. This is your first and biggest win — cheapest revenue in the business, currently untouched. • Lifecycle marketing. Segmentation, automated flows, win-backs, and a send calendar that runs without being chased. • Organic and social. Turning a shop full of talented barbers into a content engine. You won’t be shooting everything yourself — you’ll build the system that makes it repeatable. • Influencer and UGC. Local creators, real partnerships, measurable outcomes. Not gifting haircuts and hoping. • The relaunch and Christmas campaigns. Both land in your first quarter. No easing in. How you’ll be measured We run a weighted scorecard, reviewed quarterly: • Qualified leads — 40% • Marketing-sourced revenue — 30% • Execution and delivery — 20% • Brand — 10% Underneath that: new clients per week, cost per acquired client, new-client rebooking rate, and reactivation rate. You’ll have a real budget and real autonomy to spend it. Who we’re looking for You’ve run lifecycle marketing that actually moved revenue, and you can point to the numbers. You’re fluent in Klaviyo or similar. You write copy people finish reading. You have opinions about what we’re doing wrong and you’ll say so in the interview. You’re not precious about channel purity — if a scrappy SMS blast outperforms a beautiful campaign, you ship the SMS blast. If your instinct is to report on impressions and follower growth, this isn’t the role. What’s in it 120k peso, performance bonus tied to the scorecard, and a genuine seat at the table as we scale. You’d also have access to School of Barbers, our sister education business, which gives you a second brand and audience to work with. To apply Send your CV and a case study on how you would build the brand

title: Amazon FBA Sourcing Assistant — Supplier Outreach & Product Research (Full-time, Long-term)

description: Hello, We're GTDISTRIBUTION, an Amazon FBA seller operating across 5 European marketplaces (France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Netherlands). Supplier outreach — 60% of your time Find wholesalers and distributors in Europe and the US, contact them by email, follow up, and qualify their offers. If you want to be pushed and get better at what you do, we'd love to talk. What we offer Full-time, fully remote, flexible hours 32,000 PHP/month to start — reviewed after 3 months based on results. We pay more for people who take on more. Complete training, with our current VA onboarding you personally A documented process, not "figure it out yourself" Long-term position with a company that's growing Who we're looking for Solid written English — you'll be emailing suppliers daily Comfortable with Google Sheets and numbers Detail-oriented — our criteria are strict and we verify the work Self-starter who tries things and asks questions when stuck, rather than staying blocked Amazon or wholesale sourcing experience is a plus, not a requirement How to apply Send us: 1. title: Meta Ads Creative Strategist
description: Job Overview We are a fast-growing Shopify direct-to-consumer (DTC) sleep technology brand, and we are looking for a highly analytical, sharp, and proactive Creative Strategist for Meta Ads. To be incredibly clear: This is NOT a graphic design or video editing role. You will not be pushing pixels in Figma or editing timelines in Premiere. You are the architect of our ad account. Your job is to conduct deep market research, understand consumer psychology, develop high-converting direct response (DR) angles, and write airtight creative briefs for our design and editing teams. You must understand why people buy and know how to structure a scroll-stopping hook and a persuasive script that sells. If you are someone who waits to be handed a list of ideas to brief, or if you just guess what might look "cool" without looking at the data, this is not the role for you. We need a strategic powerhouse who owns the creative testing roadmap from insight to execution to analysis. Core Responsibilities - Deep Avatar & Market Research: Obsessively research our target demographic. You will scour competitor ad libraries, mine customer reviews, read Reddit threads, and analyze TikTok comments to uncover hidden pain points and desires. - Angle & Concept Ideation: Develop original, direct response advertising angles. You will translate your research into structured concepts (e.g., problem/solution, Us vs. Them, scientific proof/temperature control comparisons, emotional triggers). - Airtight Creative Briefing: Write highly detailed, idiot-proof creative briefs and video scripts for our designers and editors. Your briefs must clearly define the hook, the visual layout, the on-screen text, the pacing, and the core CTA. - Creative Performance Analysis: You won't just launch briefs and forget them. You will actively analyze performance data in Meta Ads Manager and our attribution software (e.g., Northbeam, Triple Whale) to diagnose hook rates, thumb-stop ratios, and CPA. You must be able to explain why an ad won or lost. - Testing Roadmap Management: Build and manage our weekly creative testing pipeline, ensuring a consistent flow of fresh concepts, iterative variations of winning ads, and new format tests. Required Qualifications & Skills - Direct Response Mastery is Mandatory: You must have a deep, proven understanding of what makes a Meta ad convert. You know the anatomy of a winning ad, consumer psychology, and how to structure a pitch that drives immediate action. - Exceptional Copywriting & Scripting: Flawless written English. You must be able to write punchy, persuasive video scripts, ad copy, and headlines that resonate with a US-based consumer. - Data Literacy: You must be comfortable reading data. You know the difference between a creative problem (low hook rate) and a landing page problem (high CTR, low CVR), and you use that data to guide your next brief. - Proactive & Independent: You do not need to be micromanaged. You independently spot fatigue in our ad account, research what competitors are scaling, and pitch your own concepts. - Reliable Setup: High-speed internet connection (with a backup plan) and a reliable computer. Nice-to-Haves (Not Mandatory) - Prior experience strategizing for sleep-tech, health/wellness, or high-AOV premium home goods brands. - Familiarity with creative research and saving tools like Foreplay or Atria. How to Apply: If you are sharp, obsessed with consumer psychology, and ready to be the brains behind our Meta ad engine, please reply with: - A link to a portfolio or Google Drive folder containing 2–3 examples of creative briefs or scripts you have written that resulted in profitable ads, and the images/videos of those ads (if available).

title: Editorial Content Writer
description: We are a fast-growing direct-to-consumer (DTC) brand looking for an exceptionally sharp, articulate Editorial Product Reviewer & AI Content Editor. In this role, you will write in-depth, third-party review articles, head-to-head product comparisons, and comprehensive breakdown blogs to be published across external media outlets and review platforms. Our audience is highly intelligent, discerning, and extremely skeptical. They instantly spot overt marketing hype, shallow buzzwords, and fake praise. Your goal is to write legitimate, highly credible, analytical product reviews that provide real substance, address actual pros and cons, and earn the reader's trust through genuine editorial depth. We do not accept raw AI slop. If your workflow is pasting a prompt into ChatGPT, copying the output, and calling it a day, this job is not for you. I can spot low-effort AI writing immediately (robotic tone, generic filler phrases, canned intros, and superficial conclusions loaded with words like "delve," "game-changer," or "testament"). We need an editor who uses AI strictly as a tool for initial research, outlines, and structural velocity, but uses their own journalistic critical thinking to strip away the fluff, rewrite the copy, and deliver a polished, authentic piece that reads exactly like a deep-dive review from a top-tier tech or lifestyle publication. Core Responsibilities • Deep-Dive Review Writing: Produce realistic, objective-sounding product reviews, multi-product roundups, and side-by-side feature comparisons for off-site publication. • AI-Assisted Drafting: Utilize modern LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, etc.) to rapidly organize product specs, outline key arguments, and generate initial rough drafts. • Deep Humanization & Editing: Completely gut AI linguistic markers. Inject natural sentence cadence, nuanced critique, balanced pros/cons, and authentic observational detail. • Nuanced Positioning: Translate complex product specs and technical mechanisms into relatable, real-world experience without sounding like a sales rep. • Structural Excellence: Format articles with clean subheadings, practical verdict summaries, pros/cons lists, and logical breakdown structures that respect a smart reader's time. Required Qualifications & Skills • Flawless Editorial & Review Skills: Exceptional command of written English with a background in digital journalism, technical reviewing, or high-level blogging. • Critical Eye for Marketing Hype: You know how to discuss a product's strengths authentically while maintaining the critical, balanced distance of an independent reviewer. • Advanced AI Prompting: Experience directing AI tools using explicit constraints, style parameters, and detailed reference briefs rather than basic prompts. • Obsessive AI Slop Detector: You instinctively catch robotic phrasing, repetitive sentence patterns, and hollow generalizations—and you know how to completely humanize them. • Reliable Setup: High-speed internet (with a backup) and a dependable workspace to consistently hit delivery deadlines. Nice-to-Haves (Not Mandatory) • Journalism / Technical Writing Background: Experience writing for tech publications, consumer testing sites, or niche editorial blogs. • Affiliate / Publisher Writing: Prior experience drafting real-world buyer's guides or product breakdown articles for online publications. How to Apply If you are sharp, highly critical of bad writing, and know how to write nuanced product reviews that intelligent readers actually trust, please reply with 2–3 links or attachments of review-style articles, buyer's guides, or editorial breakdowns you have written. (Before/After samples showing a raw AI draft versus your final humanized piece are strongly encouraged and will jump to the top).

title: E-Commerce Product Researcher – Funnel-Focused Products, Meta ads
job_title: E-Commerce Product Researcher – Funnel-Focused Products, Meta ads
description: We are a fast-growing e-commerce business building and scaling direct-response brands across multiple markets. As we expand into new countries and launch additional products, we are seeking an expert Product Researcher who understands how to identify products specifically suited to high-converting sales funnels and dedicated landing pages. This is not a standard dropshipping product research role focused on finding products to upload directly to Shopify product pages. We are looking for funnel-focused products that can be sold through a dedicated customer journey, typically moving from a paid social advertisement to an advertorial or listicle and then to a high-converting landing page or sales funnel. We are willing to pay well for someone with genuine expertise who can consistently identify high-quality opportunities rather than submit large lists of random products. ### Job Responsibilities * Research and identify high-potential products suited to sales funnels, advertorials, listicles and dedicated landing pages. * Find products with strong direct-response potential that can be marketed around a clear problem, desire, transformation or unique angle. * Research products that are already demonstrating demand while identifying opportunities that have not yet become completely saturated. * Use the Facebook Ad Library extensively to ---------- competitors, active advertisements, creative angles, advertorials, listicles, landing pages, offers and brands that are currently scaling. * Use TrendTrack and other current product and trend research platforms to identify emerging products and opportunities. * Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and other relevant platforms to expand product research, discover alternative keywords, identify product terminology, uncover customer problems, explore niche terminology and generate competitor search terms. * Go beyond obvious product names when researching. We expect you to uncover different keywords, synonyms, problem-based searches and marketing angles that help reveal products others may miss. * Analyse competitor funnels from the advertisement through to the advertorial or listicle, landing page, offer structure, bundles and upsells. * Identify products with strong potential for bundling and increasing average order value. * Prioritise shipping-friendly products, ideally smaller and lightweight items that are inexpensive and straightforward to fulfil internationally. * Avoid products that are excessively large, fragile, extremely heavy or otherwise difficult and expensive to ship. * Evaluate sourcing opportunities, approximate product costs, perceived value, potential selling prices and available margins. * Research whether multiple quantities, bundles or complementary products could create stronger offers. * Provide clear reasoning behind every product recommendation rather than simply submitting product links. * Stay up to date with changing advertising trends, winning funnels, emerging niches, competitor strategies and new research tools. * Communicate and collaborate effectively through Slack, which is required for day-to-day team communication and project updates. ### What We Are Looking For We are specifically seeking an experienced e-commerce product researcher, not someone looking to learn product research from scratch. You should have: * Proven experience researching winning or scalable e-commerce products. * Strong experience researching products designed to be sold through funnels, advertorials, listicles and dedicated landing pages rather than standard Shopify product pages alone. * Expert knowledge of the Facebook Ad Library and the ability to conduct deep competitor research rather than basic searches. * Experience using TrendTrack or similar modern product and advertising research platforms. * A strong understanding of direct-response marketing and what makes a product suitable for a funnel. * A solid understanding of product-market fit, customer pain points, emotional buying triggers and marketing angles. * The ability to distinguish between a product that simply looks interesting and one that could realistically support a profitable advertising campaign. * A strong understanding of bundles, quantity breaks, upsells and offer creation. * The ability to assess shipping considerations, sourcing costs, margins and perceived product value. * Experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude and other relevant platforms for advanced research, including generating search terms, alternative keywords, niche terminology and research directions. * Strong analytical skills and excellent attention to detail. * Fluent English and the ability to clearly explain why you believe a product has potential. * Familiarity with Slack and the ability to use it reliably for communication, collaboration and sharing research updates. * A proactive mindset. We do not want someone who needs to be told exactly which keywords to search or where to look. * Please include word 'blue' in your application so we know you have read and understood the job post fully. ### Exclusivity & Confidentiality This is extremely important to us. We do not want someone simultaneously researching and supplying the same products or opportunities to other e-commerce businesses. The products, competitors, funnels, niches and opportunities you discover while working with us must remain confidential. You will be required to sign an NDA or confidentiality agreement before beginning work with us. We are looking to build a long-term relationship with someone who becomes an important part of our product development and scaling process. ### Compensation & Growth We are willing to pay for expertise. We are not looking for the cheapest product researcher available. If you can consistently identify genuinely strong products and opportunities, we are happy to compensate you accordingly. Compensation can be structured around experience, workload and results. This is not intended to be a short-term position. Our team is growing rapidly, and we are expanding into additional international markets. As a result, our need for product research will continue to increase. For the right person, there is significant room to grow with the company, take on greater responsibility and become a key part of our wider product research and development operation. ### What We Value We want someone who: * Thinks independently. * Understands direct-response e-commerce. * Is naturally curious and enjoys digging deeper than competitors. * Keeps up with the latest research tools and methods. * Can recognise trends early. * Understands that quality is more important than quantity. * Can explain the reasoning and evidence behind every recommendation. * Communicates consistently and effectively through Slack. * Wants to work long-term with a growing e-commerce team. ### How to Apply If you believe you are an expert e-commerce product researcher, we would like to hear from you. Please include: * Your previous product research experience. * The research tools you currently use. * Your experience with the Facebook Ad Library. * Your experience with TrendTrack or similar platforms. * How you identify products suitable for funnels, advertorials or listicles rather than standard product pages. * Examples of products you have previously discovered that went on to perform successfully, where possible. * How you use AI within your product research workflow. * Your familiarity and experience with Slack. * Your availability and preferred compensation structure. * The word “blue” to confirm that you have read and understood this job post fully. Please do not send a generic application. We are looking for someone who already understands advanced product research and can demonstrate a clear process for finding products with genuine funnel and scaling potential. If you are excellent at finding opportunities before everyone else does and want to become part of a growing e-commerce team expanding into new markets, we would love to hear from you.

description: Full-time | Remote Salary: PHP 40,000 per month The Coaches Business Studio About the role The Coaches Business Studio is building a digital education platform for professional coaches, delivered primarily through an AI faculty. Our Course Producers create the core presenter videos using platforms such as HeyGen and Synthesia.
