title: Amazon and eBay Marketplace Manager / Product Listing Specialist
job_title: Amazon and eBay Marketplace Manager / Product Listing Specialist
description: Job Overview We are looking for an experienced Amazon and eBay Marketplace Manager to take ownership of our product listings, marketplace presentation, pricing accuracy, stock control, and overall account performance across Amazon Seller Central and eBay. This role is ideal for someone who has extensive hands-on experience listing products on Amazon and eBay, understands how marketplace seller centers work, and knows how to create listings that are accurate, commercially strong, and optimised to generate sales. The successful candidate will be responsible for setting up new products, managing existing listings, creating correct variants, maintaining accurate pricing, monitoring stock levels, and working closely with our internal teams to keep both marketplace accounts running smoothly. This is not just a basic product upload role. We are looking for someone who understands how to structure listings properly, how to optimise product pages for conversion, and how to manage the operational side of marketplace selling. Key Responsibilities 1. Product Listing Management You will be responsible for creating, updating, and maintaining product listings across Amazon and eBay. This includes: - Create new product listings on Amazon Seller Central and eBay - Ensuring all listings are accurate, complete, and professionally presented - Writing or improving product titles, bullet points, descriptions, item specifics, and product details - Making sure listings are set up in the correct categories - Uploading high-quality product images and ensuring image order is suitable for sales conversion - Ensuring product dimensions, weights, SKUs, barcodes, variations, pricing, and delivery information are correct - Review existing listings and improve them where needed - Identifying poor-performing listings and making changes to improve visibility and conversion - Keeping listings consistent across Amazon, eBay, and internal systems. 2. Amazon Seller Central Management The candidate must have strong experience using Amazon Seller Central and must understand how to manage Amazon listings properly. Responsibilities include: - Creating and managing Amazon product listings - Building parent and child variation listings correctly - Understanding how Amazon variation structures work, including size, colour, weight, bundle, and product-type variations - Fixing listing errors, suppressed listings, inactive listings, and stranded inventory issues - Managing product content, titles, bullet points, descriptions, browse nodes, product IDs, and backend search terms - Monitoring listing health and account performance - Understanding Amazon catalogue rules and how to avoid listing conflicts - Managing pricing, stock availability, delivery settings, and fulfilment settings - Working with the wider team to ensure Amazon listings accurately reflect available stock and incoming stock - Helping improve Amazon sales performance through better listing structure and optimisation 3. eBay Seller Centre Management The candidate must also be confident using eBay’s seller platform and understand how to create strong, accurate, and high-converting eBay listings. Responsibilities include: - Creating and managing eBay listings - Setting up variations correctly within eBay - Ensuring item specifics are complete and accurate - Managing product titles, descriptions, images, pricing, postage settings, and return settings - Reviewing eBay listing performance and identifying opportunities for improvement - Managing stock quantities and availability - Ensuring listings are compliant with eBay policies - Keeping eBay listings clean, accurate, and commercially competitive Additional Role Requirements The ideal candidate should have excellent attention to detail, strong organisational skills, and the ability to work independently without needing constant direction. They should be confident managing multiple tasks at once, spotting potential issues early, and communicating clearly with the relevant teams when something needs attention. Experience with bulk uploads, Amazon flat files, eBay listing tools, inventory systems, marketplace SEO, fitness products, bulky goods, or products with multiple size and weight variations would be beneficial. How to Apply: Please send your application with the subject line: Amazon & eBay Specialist – [Your Full Name] Your application should include: - Your updated CV/resume - A short summary of your Amazon and eBay marketplace experience - Examples of marketplaces, brands, or product categories you have managed - A brief explanation of your experience using: Amazon Seller Central eBay Seller Hub - Any experience with: Amazon flat files Bulk uploads Inventory systems Variation listings Marketplace SEO Applicants with strong hands-on experience managing Amazon and eBay marketplaces, particularly with complex product listings and variation structures, will be prioritised.

title: Founding Team Members — Sales & Operations (AI Marketplace Startup)
job_title: Founding Team Members — Sales & Operations (AI Marketplace Startup)
description: Adding outbound sales executives- if incentives based sales is your expertise - let's talk. Who We Are WorkBench is an AI-powered local services marketplace connecting clients to workers in Los Angeles with speed, trust, and operational precision. We are in the early stages of building a two-sided marketplace — and we are assembling a founding team that can grow with us from zero to scale. This is not a VA job. This is not a script-following role. This is a founding team seat with real ownership, real accountability, and real growth. We are hiring two people simultaneously who will work as a unit from Day 1: Role 1 — Sales Operator Role 2 — Operations Coordinator We are building the playbook as we go. You will be doing the work and documenting it at the same time. You will test, iterate, and refine — without waiting to be told what to do next. If you need a lot of hand-holding, this is not the right fit. You must bring all of the following: Fluent, confident spoken English with strong phone presence — both roles will be on live calls. Sales cold calls clients. Ops cold calls and recruits workers in the LA market. Conversations must be natural and impromptu. We use a call guide, not a script. If your phone game is weak, this role is not for you. Strong AI proficiency — you should already be using AI tools in your daily work, not learning what they are. We build AI-first and expect the same from our team. Sharp, fast thinking — you will encounter situations no SOP has covered yet. We need people who can reason through problems independently, not freeze. Resourcefulness — search, test, figure it out. Escalate only after you have already tried. Comfort with pressure — early-stage startups are not linear. Priorities shift and timelines compress. Stay sharp regardless. Management potential with hands-on execution — you should be capable of stepping into a lead role while still doing the ground-level work yourself. We are building this together. Long-term orientation — we want people who want to grow with the company, not people looking for short gigs. Role 1: Sales Operator What You'll Do: Research and identify LA-based SMBs — property managers are the primary target Execute cold outreach across email , LinkedIn, and phone — conversational and personalized, never templated Book qualified demos and conduct Loom walkthroughs for prospects Maintain clean, detailed CRM records in HubSpot at all times Document client requirements clearly for Ops handoff after every closed deal Build and refine the sales SOP as you work — you are writing the playbook, not following one You're a Fit If: You can open a cold call without a script and keep a conversation going naturally You have done outbound before and know what actually makes someone respond You think in systems — not just "did I send the email " but "is this sequence working" You are competitive, consistent, and do not need daily motivation from a manager Success Metrics Consistent qualified demos booked weekly HubSpot pipeline hygiene maintained without prompting Clean, detailed handoff notes delivered to Ops after every deal Role 2: Operations Coordinator What You'll Do In the first few months: cold call, reach out, and sign up workers in the LA market — you are building the supply side of the marketplace from scratch via phone and direct outreach Build and execute client onboarding workflows from start to finish Translate what Sales promises into clear, executable delivery steps Coordinate service providers, schedules, and client communications Create and maintain SOPs, checklists, and tracking systems in Sheets, Notion, and HubSpot Identify gaps and breakdowns before they become problems You're a Fit If: You are confident and natural on the phone — you will be cold calling real people in the US and convincing them to join a platform they have never heard of You have a bias for documentation — if it is not written down, it does not exist to you You can manage multiple moving parts without a project manager directing your next step You can push back on Sales when a promise is not operationally realistic — professionally and immediately You find broken processes irritating and instinctively fix them Success Metrics Worker recruitment targets met in the first 60–90 days Client onboarding completed within 24–48 hours of deal close Zero client confusion after handoff SOPs updated in real time, not retroactively How You'll Work Together Daily 15-30-minute sync with the Strategic Operations Manager Structured Sales ? Ops handoff required for every client — no exceptions Solve problems together before escalating — your manager is not your first call Joint accountability for client success from close through delivery Compensation Sales Operator: $10–$14/hr based on experience and fit + performance bonuses Operations Coordinator: $8–$12/hr based on experience and fit + performance incentives Both roles: 13th-month bonus (pro-rated) | Leadership growth path for the right candidates HOW TO APPLY (Please read carefully and follow the instructions) Send your application here in Onlinejobs.ph with the subject line: [Role You're Applying For] — Your Full Name (e.g. Sales Operator — Juan dela Cruz). Your application must include: Your cover letter with complete answers to all screening questions below Link to your resume Link to a voice recording - Vocaroo or Speakpipe or any publicly accessible link to a recording of a real outbound call you have made — cold call, follow-up, or recruitment call. No existing recording? Send us a self introduction instead and why you think you're the perfect fit for the role **NOTE: Incomplete applications will not be reviewed. Screening Questions Core Questions — Both Roles Tell us about a time something went wrong while working remotely with a teammate. What did you do, and what was the outcome? A client is clearly unhappy but will not say why. Walk us through exactly how you handle it. What does ownership mean to you in a remote role? Give a specific example. Your teammate's pace is slowing your work down. What do you do? Why do you want to be part of an early-stage startup instead of a stable job — and be honest? Sales-Specific Questions Walk us through how you would research a property management company in Los Angeles before reaching out. Write a 2-sentence cold email to a property manager in LA. No templates — make it feel human. Record a short Loom (2–3 min) explaining what WorkBench does as if you are talking to a prospect for the first time. We are looking for clarity, confidence, and conversational delivery — not a rehearsed pitch. What makes someone actually respond to cold outreach today? What information do you always pass to Operations after a client says yes? Operations-Specific Questions Build a simple onboarding checklist for a new WorkBench client. Show us how you think. How do you make sure nothing falls through the cracks when managing multiple clients at once? What tools do you use for tracking work and why? Don't just name them — explain the logic. Sales promises a client a turnaround that cannot be delivered in that timeframe. What do you do? Everything is urgent. How do you d ---------- what gets done first? You are cold calling a handyman in Los Angeles to sign up on a new platform they have never heard of. You have 60 seconds before they hang up. What do you say? A worker you have been trying to recruit keeps stalling — interested but not committing. How do you follow up without burning the relationship? Pair Evaluation Sales just closed a client. Walk through the exact handoff process step by step. Ops says onboarding will take 3 days. Sales told the client 1 day. Resolve this — live. A client sends completely unclear instructions. Who owns clarification, and how does it get done? How often should Sales and Ops communicate with each other without the manager involved? What is one thing about this opportunity that gives you pause — and how do you think about it? WorkBench is building something real. We want people who are too.

title: Customer Service and Support
description: We run a US-based, court-mandated, online education program that is completed by people who have driven under the influence of alcohol.   Program participants watch 11 stories from both victims and offenders, with each storyteller detailing how their lives were impacted by a choice to drive impaired.  Program participants are required to answer questions throughout the program to check for understanding and ensure their active participation.  Often, our participants begin the program feeling angry and frustrated, but by the end of the program they often feel empowered and hopeful in their ability to make safer choices in the future. Program users are required to register, pay a fee and complete the program within a 5 day timeframe.  There are many steps from registration through program completion where a program user may need assistance or encouragement.  We field phone calls from participants needing help and support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and 365 days a year.  We are needing to hire one person with availability from 3:00pm EST to 11:00 pm EST (we are based on the east coast of the United States), Monday through Friday.  We are expecting a higher second employee for this role at a later date. It is important that this customer service and support professional can work with people over the phone who may be stressed, nervous, or even angry.  We pride ourselves on our empathetic approach to customer service and it is important to lead with compassion.  Our program graduates frequently share that the customer service and support they receive from us made a difference.  We want our customers to feel confident, understood and supported by the end of our conversation with them. Here are some of the things that you may have to help them with: - Registration and Signing Up - wanting more information about the YouImpact program prior to paying, problems with payment not going through, coupon code eligibility, expired accounts and determining eligibility for reactivation, finding information required at the time of registration - Completing the program - changing the program language, program navigation, wrong answer alerts - Post-program concerns - proof of program completion for the court system These are the skills and knowledge that the ideal candidate would need to posses: - Strong verbal/phone and written English communication skills - support is split between phone calls and email s - Comfortable communicating with people of varying abilities and communication styles - Follow communication “scripts” when handling different topics - but be able to put your personal touch on the interaction - Ability to independently trouble-shoot technical issues - In order to communicate with our customers, you will need consistent/high-quality internet access. - Familiarity with CRM systems and practices - we use HubSpot - E-Mail, Google Docs, Google Sheets, Google Voice It is expected that there will be lots of questions and a frequent need for clarification by the person hired.  If you are not comfortable asking for assistance, this is not the position for you.  We will make ourselves available to you frequently to support you. Our program works, and we have data that shows we have the lowest r ---------- rate of all available programs.  Currently, we have 16,000 people a year take our program.  We want people to use our program because it saves lives. Our company’s founder lost her infant child to an impaired driver and she developed this program to be an inspiration for change because showing compassion is truly how we help people do better.  We do not subscribe to the idea that you can shame or punish away bad behavior and this is reflected in how we interact with customers.

title: Ghostwriter
description: About Us We help established entrepreneurs build media authority. That includes magazine features, TV placements, and book publishing. Our clients are business owners, executives, and industry leaders who want to be seen as the go-to voice in their space. The book publishing service is one of the most personal and high-touch offerings we provide. A book is not just content. It is a credibility asset. It opens stages, closes deals, and defines how a client's market sees them for years. This role sits at the center of that service. WHAT THIS ROLE IS This is a ghostwriting role. You are not writing blog posts or social media captions. You are writing full-length non-fiction books on behalf of our clients. The clients are business owners. Their books are tools. Think: leadership principles, business methodology, entrepreneurial journey, industry insight. The goal of every book is to establish the client as an authority and attract more of the right people to their business. You will take everything in a client's head and turn it into a readable, well-structured, professionally written book that sounds exactly like them. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Get on video calls with clients to conduct deep-dive interviews and extract their story, knowledge, and ideas - Build rapport quickly and ask the right questions to draw out the content they did not know they had - Develop a clear book structure and outline before writing begins - Write in the client's voice, not yours - Manage the full writing process from first interview to final manuscript - Communicate proactively with clients throughout the project so they always know where things stand - Deliver clean, well-organized drafts on schedule - Incorporate feedback and revisions without ego WHAT YOU NEED Non-negotiable: - Proven experience ghostwriting non-fiction books (portfolio required) - Strong client-facing communication skills. You will be on video calls with busy, high-achieving business owners. You need to make them comfortable, keep things moving, and ask smart questions. - Ability to write in someone else's voice and match their tone, cadence, and perspective - Experience structuring long-form content (books, not just articles) - Reliable communication and self-managed workflow Strong plus: - Background in or knowledge of business, entrepreneurship, or leadership content - Experience writing authority-positioning or thought leadership books - Comfort working with clients who have big ideas but are not natural writers WHAT IT'S NOT This is not a copywriting role. This is not an article writing role. This is not social media. If your ghostwriting experience is limited to short-form content, this is not the right fit.

description: About Us Our company is the cultural infrastructure layer for upstream youth mental health. We build fan-native experiences — like a post-concert QR scan that lets fans capture an emotional ---------- nt and get a beautiful shareable artifact back — that quietly deliver evidence-based protective factors to young people in the language they already speak. description: Who We Are: Ji Martial Arts is a martial arts brand founded by brothers Joel and Joshua Iyalla. Joshua is a 3x British Taekwondo Champion and Guinness World Record holder. Together they are content creators with a combined 3.5 million followers, known for high-energy martial arts content, world record attempts, and comedy challenges. Your Role: You are the Operations Manager for Ji Martial Arts. Your job is to keep the business running smoothly across four core areas — YouTube content, UGC, finance and organisation, and Facebook ads. You are not just executing tasks. You are managing and building systems, documenting them, and making sure everything is replicable without you having to explain it twice. When something looks off, you flag it. When a process could be better, you say so. Growth is always on your mind — whatever you're working on, you're always asking how we can do it better. If Joel and Joshua go away for weeks, the business doesn't just survive — it thrives. That is the standard we are hiring to. What You Own: 1. YouTube Long-Form Content: You own the end-to-end workflow for 7 videos per week. The system is built. You run it, improve it, and grow it. This includes idea generation using our Notion bot, managing the editor through briefing and approval, scheduling, thumbnails, titles, and descriptions. You own the performance data and bring a clear point of view every week on how we grow the channel. 2. UGC Creator System: You oversee our UGC pipeline — onboarding creators, managing their deliverables, and maintaining the content bank in Airtable and Notion. You keep the pipeline clean and always look for ways to improve the quality and output of the creator pool. 3. Organisation & Finance: Notion and Airtable are our operational nervous system. Xero is our financial backbone. You keep all three clean, current, and easy to navigate. You create SOPs and Loom walkthroughs for every process so nothing lives only in someone's head. You flag financial anomalies early — nothing slips. 4. Facebook Ads — Backup Ownership: Joel and Joshua run the ads day-to-day. When we're unavailable, you step in fully — writing scripts, briefing the editor, reviewing creatives, and uploading to Ads Manager with the correct copy and settings (You’ll have SOP’s to follow to make this easy). You handle it independently and flag us only when something genuinely needs our eyes. 5. Run the Business: This is the underlying point of everything above. If Joel and Joshua are away for four weeks, six weeks, or longer — the business does not slow down. It grows. You are not a caretaker. You are the person who keeps Ji moving, improving, and scaling in our absence. Every system you build, every process you document, every decision you make should be with that standard in mind. Tools You'll Use: *(Includes but is not limited to)* | Notion | Operating hub — SOPs, scripts, content system | | Airtable | UGC content bank and pipeline management | | Xero | Financial tracking and reconciliation | | YouTube Studio | Scheduling and performance analysis | | Meta Ads Manager | Ad backup — campaign management and uploading | | Loom | SOP and process documentation | | Claude/ chatgpt | Expediting efficiency and brainstorming | How Your Week Works: - YouTube — scripting, editor coordination, scheduling, and performance review on a rolling weekly basis in line with the 7-video target - UGC — creator communications and pipeline management are ongoing - Organisation — Notion and Airtable are always tidy; Xero is never left to fall behind, statements reconciled weekly - Ads — when needed, you're ready to step in without a handover Who We're Looking For: - Proven operations or systems management experience — we will not be your training ground - Strong Notion skills — fluent and able to optimise existing workspaces - Comfortable with Airtable and basic financial literacy in Xero - Experience building SOPs and documenting processes via Loom - Experience coordinating remote creative teams The person: proactive, self-directed, communicative, intuitive, growth-minded. You don't wait to be told what to do — you tell us what you're doing. Radio silence is not in your How We Communicate: - A brief message at the start of your day — what you're working on - A summary at the end of the day — what got done and what didn't - Weekly video call with Joel and Joshua — sync, progress, priorities - All communication via WhatsApp group We are not micromanagers. What we expect is simple: we never have to chase you. Growth & Progression: This starts at ~15 hours per week at $8–$10/hr. As Ji scales, hours increase, your team grows beneath you, and your pay grows with it. We are scaling fast and actively looking to hand more of the business over to the right person. This is a long-term role with real progression — not a short-term contract. How to Apply: Complete our short application form below — five focused questions. You won't be siloed into one channel or task. We need someone who can develop strategy, execute their plan, and leverage the tools available to them (which are many). Bring back what you're hearing from the audience so the product team can act on it REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE - Demonstrated experience running integrated digital marketing campaigns (not just one channel) - Treats AI as a power tool: leverages it heavily, reviews everything, owns the final output - Communicates clearly and honestly about what's working and what isn't WHAT WE'RE OFFERING - 10 hours/week to start, scaling to 15–20 after a successful probation period - title: Senior Product Intelligence Analyst (Amazon DTC, US Supplement Brand)
job_title: Senior Product Intelligence Analyst (Amazon DTC, US Supplement Brand)
description: PHP 208,000/month base. Bonus on top. Direct hire by a US founder who's built two supplement brands in the New York area. Not an agency. Not a BPO. You'll be the senior analyst seat at a US-based supplement and functional food company. You live inside Amazon Brand Analytics, SmartScout, Helium 10, and DataDive every day. You spot category opportunities. You write the niche analyses that drive what products we launch. You iterate with our internal AI systems to land usable outputs. This is strategic work. Not data entry. Not VA tasks. Not transcription. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- THE JOB You're our detective and our analyst. You don't formulate. You don't run ads. You don't manage anyone. Half the week, you live in Brand Analytics, SmartScout, Helium 10, DataDive, Kalodata, and on competitor product pages. You're watching click share shift on the keywords that matter. You're noticing when an emerging brand jumps three tiers in 60 days and asking why. You're tracking which branded ingredients are getting picked up by which mid-market brands. You're spotting new entrants before they hit page one. You're catching what's trending on Reddit and Google Trends before it shows up on Amazon BA. The other half, you turn observations into niche analyses and iterate with our AI product development system. When something is worth pursuing, you produce a structured research document defining the opportunity: market size, keyword landscape with realistic and stretch targets, top 10 competitor table with revenue and formulas, competitor packaging analysis, regulatory flags, and a clear strategic angle with competitive positioning recommendation. Tight. Opinionated. Numbers cited. That analysis plus our weekly market intelligence report feed into an internal AI-powered product development system. The system produces proposals, packaging concepts, wireframes, spec sheets, and supplier quotes. Cadence: 1-2 niche analyses per week from initial research through final brief. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ THE WEDGE DISCIPLINE Every niche analysis must answer one sentence: why does a customer click us instead of the top three incumbents already on page one? Format wedge. Ingredient wedge. Audience wedge. Claim wedge. One of those four has to be defensible, or the analysis isn't ready to ship to the build pipeline. You will be the person who finds that wedge and writes the case for it. If you read this and think "yeah, obviously," we should talk. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- YOU QUALIFY IF: - 3-5 years at a US-based DTC brand, Amazon-native operation, or ecommerce agency doing product or category research - You've pulled Brand Analytics. You've used SmartScout or Helium 10 or DataDive in a real job - You can read a Top Search Terms report and explain what 70% click share at 1% conversion share means - You know what a 12 month growth +49% with 1 month growth -3% on a 730-day-old listing tells you, and how that differs from the same numbers on a 90-day-old listing - You recognize branded ingredients (Creapure, KSM-66, Magtein, Affron, GlucoVantage, AstaReal) and can verify a dose or form claim quickly - You understand basic supplement regulatory compliance: structure/function vs. disease claims, NDI status, GLP-1 framing risk, kids product compliance - You understand TACoS at launch vs. mature phase. You can talk to a PPC operator about CPR and rank cost Supplement, beauty, or functional food category experience preferred (supplements strongest) - Native or near-native English writing. Tight. No filler. No hedging. -2-3 hours of overlap with US Eastern Time during business hours required (your specific window is flexible) ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ YOU DO NOT QUALIFY IF: -You're a VA looking for any remote US gig -You've never used Brand Analytics or Helium 10 in a real job -You want a research assistant role with no strategic ownership -AI feels like a threat to your craft -You hedge in your writing -Iterating with imperfect AI tools multiple rounds per project sounds tedious HOW YOU'LL USE AI Our internal systems are AI-powered. The weekly market intelligence report is AI-generated. The product development pipeline is AI-powered. The AI does the heavy drafting. Your judgment is the shipping layer. Expect 3-5 iteration rounds on a clean brief, more on novel categories. Wrong doses. Non-compliant claims. Suppliers we can't source from. Capsule fit math that's off. You catch them, you push back with specific corrections, the system reworks. You're already using Claude or ChatGPT for 30%+ of your daily work. You have opinions about prompt structure. You've hit hallucinations and learned to spot them. YEAR 1 TARGETS 90 days: -Onboarded on the weekly market intelligence system, the product development pipeline, our branded ingredient library, and our regulatory framework - 4-6 niche analyses produced - Catching the majority of compliance errors and supplier mismatches in AI output before founder review 6 months: - 1-2 niche analyses per week as standard cadence - 4-6 of those analyses moved through the build pipeline to packaging or wireframe stage - Owning the unclaimed wedge cross-reference table updates weekly 12 months: - 40-60 niche analyses written across the year - 8-12 SKUs in market or in-progress trace back to your analyses - You own the weekly market intelligence read; founder reviews instead of produces COMPENSATION - Base: PHP 208,000/month ($45,000 USD/year) - Bonus: $2,500 USD per launched SKU that crosses $30,000 USD monthly revenue within 90 days of launch. Uncapped. Paid at the 90-day mark per SKU. - Paid via Wise, Payoneer, or direct bank transfer (your preference), Bi weekly - 20 working days PTO per year plus Philippines public holidays - Laptop and second monitor provided after 90-day mark - 90-day trial with clear deliverables. Both sides can exit cleanly. - Growth path to PHP 250, ---------- ,000/month range in 18-24 months as the role expands HOW TO APPLY Send to ---------- 1. Resume. One to two pages, English. 2. Two writing samples. Research documents, product briefs, strategy memos, internal docs you've produced for previous employers. We're judging the writing quality, not the topic. Work product from a US-based brand is a plus. 3. A 500-word take. Pick a supplement category on Amazon we should NOT enter. Name the category. Name three incumbents on page one. Show your data. Tell us why entering is a bad call. Be opinionated. ChatGPT-generic answers get cut on the first read. 4. A 10-minute Loom video. Open Amazon. Pick one supplement category you'd advise us to enter and one to skip. Five minutes each. Show your screen. Read the data out loud. Don't just describe the listings. Tell us what you'd dig into next and why. If we're interested: a paid 48-hour take-home ($100 USD) where we share a sample market report and ask you to produce one niche analysis. Then a 90-minute video working session with the founder reading data together. Then references. No phone screens. No 6-round panels. Two weeks to apply. One seat. We move fast on the right candidate. Thanks

title: Project Manager
description: Organization: Non Profit Hours: Part-time, flexible (estimated 15-25 hrs/week to start, may grow) Compensation: $7-10/hr USD Time Zone: EST ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION It started with a storm. After a hurricane devastated communities across Puerto Rico, a small team of volunteers showed up with tools, food, and a simple belief: people deserve to be helped. Three years later, that belief has become 200+ missions, 1435+ roofs repaired, 33 farms supported, 1,100 people fed - and a verified world record of 1.1 million acts of kindness in a single week. Now the movement is going global. Our Pay It Forward campaign is scaling to 200 countries with a goal of 1 billion acts of kindness. We are a local Puerto Rico and federally certified 501(c)(3) non-profit, and we operate the same way we always have - lean, mission-first, and built on people who actually care. If you want a role where your work shows up in someone's life, not just a dashboard, this might be your place. THE ROLE You are the glue between our systems and our people. We have a fully built tech infrastructure: Notion, Airtable, Slack, OneDrive, and Claude AI. Our systems developer has designed and documented the full setup and is creating SOPs and training videos. But he's a builder, not a manager. That's where you come in. Your job is to make sure people actually use the system. You help onboard new team members. You follow up when tasks go quiet. You answer questions when someone gets stuck. You are the human layer between a smart system and a growing global team of volunteers. The system is the engine. You make sure everyone knows how to drive it - and that no one stalls out. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING Onboarding and Training - Onboard new regional managers, country directors, and core team volunteers into the tech stack (Notion, Airtable, Slack) - Walk them through SOPs and training materials created by the developer - Answer questions, troubleshoot access issues, and make sure everyone is set up and confident - Be the first point of contact for anyone joining the global team Project Coordination - Track tasks and milestones across the global team - Follow up with team members on deadlines, deliverables, and incomplete tasks - Send reminders, check in on progress, and flag blockers to leadership - Keep the Notion workspace and Airtable organized and current Systems Support -Know the tech stack inside and out -Identify when something is broken, confusing, or needs improvement -Coordinate with the developer or leadership when system changes are needed -Use Claude AI to support documentation, queries, and process improvements Communication -Attend brief weekly check-ins with leadership -Provide simple status updates on team activity and progress WHO YOU ARE Must-haves: - Solid experience with Notion and Airtable - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) - Must have Project Management experience - Must have reliable internet connection - Experience with volunteer-driven or non-profit organizations is a plus - Experience in Lovable and Wordpress website updating is a plus Personality fit: - Patient and people-oriented - you're working with volunteers, not employees. They need clarity and encouragement, not pressure. - Communicative - you surface problems early instead of waiting for them to grow - Mission-driven - you understand that behind every task is a real person who needed help - Calm under ambiguity - things are still being built, and you're okay with that

You’ll be in the front seat, driving growth and learning the strategies that power real deals across multiple U.S. markets. 4+ years building production WordPress sites with Elementor Pro - Strong experience with Crocoblock / JetEngine ecosystem in real projects (not just tutorials) - Solid understanding of WooCommerce - Comfortable writing custom CSS and basic JavaScript when widgets aren't enough - Have unreliable internet. Avoid communicating when something is delayed or unclear. ## What’s In It For You - You’ll be part of a kind, mission-driven team doing work that genuinely helps pets and their families. - You’ll get to work on meaningful online events that reach thousands of pet parents. - You’ll have the opportunity to grow from technical execution into stronger systems, reporting, automation, and technical operations work. - You’ll be encouraged to improve processes, suggest better ways of doing things, and help build systems that scale. - You’ll be part of a company with a big vision: impacting 1 million pet parents by 2030. ## How to Apply Please include the following in your application: 1. The site will include approximately 12 core pages/templates, including: Home Start Here Episodes index with filters and search Individual episode page template About Starter Week newsletter landing page Work With Jack Contact Merch coming soon page Privacy Policy Terms + Disclaimers 404 page The site must make it easy for a visitor to: Understand the show quickly Listen to the latest episode Find a good “Start Here” episode Browse by topic or season Read show notes and transcripts Join the email list Submit sponsor, speaking, or partnership inquiries Core Website Requirements WordPress Build Build the site in WordPress Use a lightweight, fast theme or custom child theme Avoid unnecessary heavy builder dependencies Gutenberg/block editor should remain usable Site must be easy for a non-technical admin to update Podcast Episode System Create a clean podcast episode system inside WordPress. This should include: Custom post type for Episodes Taxonomies for: Season Topic Format Custom fields for: Episode number Short hook Key takeaways Practice / experiment Transcript Resources / links Apple / Spotify / YouTube / RSS links Optional sponsor block Podcast RSS Automation The site must support podcast RSS import. Required: Import episodes from podcast host RSS feed Auto-create episode pages from imported episodes Pull in title, date, description, audio/player, and episode artwork where available Support automatic or scheduled publishing Allow manual transcript entry after import Make season/topic tagging fast and simple in the admin panel Episode Pages Each episode page should include: Episode title Short hook Embedded audio player Subscribe/listen buttons Key takeaways Practice / experiment Transcript section Related episodes by topic Newsletter signup CTA Episodes Index The Episodes page should include: Search bar Season filter Topic filter Format filter Episode cards with title, hook, play button, transcript/show notes link, and tags Newsletter Integration The site must include newsletter signup for Starter Week. Preferred Skills and Experience Strong WordPress design and development experience Experience building podcast, media, creator, education, or speaker websites Experience with podcast RSS feed imports Experience creating custom post types, taxonomies, and custom fields Strong responsive design skills Strong UI/UX sense SEO setup experience GA4 and Search Console setup experience Experience with newsletter integrations Ability to build clean admin workflows Good communication and reliable project management Ability to explain technical decisions clearly Preferred Tools / Platforms Experience with any of the following is helpful: WordPress Gutenberg/block editor Advanced Custom Fields Custom Post Type UI or custom-coded CPTs Elementor, only if lightweight and not overused Rank Math or Yoast WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, or similar caching tools Gravity Forms, Fluent Forms, Contact Form 7, or similar beehiiv Substack ConvertKit MailerLite Mailchimp Google Analytics 4 Google Search Console Figma Adobe XD Canva Important Notes Please do not apply if you only build simple landing pages from generic templates. Post-Event: Send replay email s, repurpose webinar content into blog posts or social content • Facebook Ad Campaign Planning — Plan and build new ad campaigns, refresh creatives, test new audiences, and present a monthly ad strategy to the Marketing Manager for approval. • Content Planning for the Month Ahead — Plan the social media calendar, blog topics, podcast episodes, newsletter themes, and any coordinated campaigns for the upcoming month. • Monthly Performance Review — Go beyond the weekly reports to summarize monthly trends: what content performed best, what drove the most leads, what to double down on, and what to cut. ???????????????????????????????????????? description: Remote (Philippines) | Full-Time | High-Ownership Career Role | US Hours Required Most support roles are a dead end. This one isn't. You're good at what you do — probably too good for where you are. You troubleshoot issues other people can't figure out. You communicate clearly when things are on fire. You take ownership of problems and drive them to resolution while everyone else is still triaging. And you're stuck. The title doesn't match the work. The growth path is vague. The team doesn't challenge you. The company doesn't see what you're capable of. We do. TOKEN OF TRUST — WHAT WE DO AND WHY IT MATTERS Token of Trust is a G2-recognized, award-winning identity verification platform. Our clients are regulated ecommerce businesses across the US who rely on us to verify real consumers, block fraud, and stay compliant — in industries where getting it wrong means legal exposure, lost revenue, or both. When checkout verification breaks on a customer's live site at 2pm on a Tuesday, we're the team that figures out why and fixes it. We ship weekly. Our last team-wide compensation increase was three months ago. When something breaks, the whole team rallies — not because they have to, but because they care. The engineering team builds the product. The operations team makes sure it works in the real world. This role is the technical backbone of that operations team. THE ROLE We're hiring a Technical Support Engineer to own technical problem-solving across our product and customer integrations. You will: * be the first person to dig into hard technical problems — the ones that require real investigation, not just a script * troubleshoot complex integration issues across WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, BigCommerce, and custom platforms * devise and test workarounds for customers, then give the product team clear, actionable information on what's wrong and how to fix it * configure and deploy our product across customer environments — and lead go-lives independently over time * write the playbooks that make recurring issues faster to resolve and easier to delegate * catch product issues before they reach customers through disciplined QA and regression testing * use AI tools daily as a force multiplier — for research, troubleshooting, analysis, and documentation This is not entry-level support. This is not a developer role. This is the kind of role where a strong technical support engineer becomes indispensable — and gets recognized for it. You do not need to write code for this role. Developer experience helps because it gives you intuition for how systems work, but what we need is someone who can configure existing products, read what a system is telling them, and explain it clearly. The ability to understand a system matters more than the ability to build one. WHO THIS IS FOR You're a strong fit if you come from technical support, implementation support, support engineering, QA, or technical operations — and you want a role where your ceiling is set by your performance, not your title. You should be: * the person your team already escalates hard problems to * someone who writes things down so the next person doesn't have to re-investigate * comfortable with structured data, API documentation, and browser dev tools * already using AI tools in your work and seeing the leverage they provide * looking for a team that will challenge you, trust you, and give you room to grow WHAT YOU'LL OWN Technical Support Leadership (Primary Focus) You'll be the senior technical resource on the Operations team — the person who handles issues that require real judgment. * triage, reproduce, and drive resolution of technical support issues * distinguish between user error, configuration issues, integration problems, and product defects * find workarounds for customers while permanent fixes are in progress * gather the right evidence before escalating to Development — so engineers can act immediately, not investigate from scratch * build and improve technical support playbooks so recurring issues can be delegated to the rest of the team * personally drive the hardest, most ambiguous, or most business-critical issues to closure * communicate clearly with customers and internal teams so the right people stay informed without unnecessary noise Where This Role Grows We're a small company, so we promise you will not get bored. Depending upon how quickly you learn, and how broad your interests, you'll be involved in other areas. As you build trust, you'll be invited to expand into spaces where your skills naturally lead, including but not limited to: * **Go-Lives and Integration Enablement** — as the strongest troubleshooter on the ops team, you'll naturally get pulled into the most important and complex client launches. You'll configure plugins and integrations across WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, and BigCommerce. You'll join screen-share sessions with customers to resolve setup issues. Over time, you could lead go-lives independently. The core skill is configuring existing systems correctly — not writing new code. * **QA and Release Confidence** — you'll be among the first to test cool new features, find nasty defects, tell development exactly what's wrong, validate fixes before production, and over time help automate regression testing. The goal: we catch issues before customers do. * **Automation and Structured Operations** — you'll use AI with our APIs, logs, and structured data (JSON, YAML, CSV) and source code to investigate and confirm behavior. description: I'm AJ, owner of an Australian design studio that's been running for 25+ years. We build websites, do graphic design (print, social, brand identity, packaging) and marketing / social media. I'm hiring one experienced graphic designer to join the team long-term and become my right hand on the production side of the business. ## About the role The role is going to be interesting and probably a bit different to what you're used to. The position is full-time and long-term. The reason the role will be interesting is because it's split between no code web development (majority of the work), PA work and Graphic design work. The job split is roughly: - 70% web production - steering Claude Code AI agent to build websites that look amazing, within a couple of frameworks we use. You'll ensure the sites content, design, information etc are correct, gathering content, optimising images, doing design-direction QC, launching sites and creating training videos showing clients how to use their website CMS. You don't need a single bit of coding experience - just a super intelligent way of approaching problems and helping the AI (which is incredibly intelligent itself) to get to the correct outcome and goal. - 10% graphic design - logos, social media packs, brochures, branded documents, packaging, signage briefs, the full mix - 15?min / project management - tracking client work in Asana, gathering content from clients, scheduling - 5% misc - light server admin, learning new tools, occasional ad-hoc The web work uses Claude Code (Anthropic's AI coding assistant) as the technical engine. You do NOT need coding skills - the AI handles ALL the coding. Your job on web work is design judgement, content input, image work, understanding Aussie culture from design and language point of view, creating high quality English training videos, quality control, testing on multiple devices etc. I will train you on all of this fully. The graphic design work is real, varied, and currently bottlenecked because I am the only one doing it. Clearing that backlog and keeping it cleared is part of why this role exists. DO NOT apply for this position if you primarily want to work on graphic design projects - this position is mostly design-leading claude code to build amazing websites for our clients, and collecting client info and content and ensuring all content and information is in the websites correctly and that each site design is amazing. Effectively, you will be steering the AI with a lot of human touches. When there's nothing to do on any websites (or Claude is off working), you'll do PA or Graphic Design work in the gaps. ## About you You absolutely must have - in order of importance: - Excellent written and spoken English. You will read client briefs, write copy in my voice, and we will communicate in writing daily. - A curious mind who enjoys learning new things and ways of doing things and the ability to problem solve your way around issues. - A Mac. The studio runs on Macbook Pros and our toolchain is not reliable on Windows. - Strong graphic design portfolio with range - brand identity, print, social/digital, packaging or signage. Not just logos. Not just one client. - Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign at minimum) - Confident with technology generally. You will learn Claude Code, Statamic CMS, and our existing tools. You do no need to a coder, or have any experience, but comfortable with software and the ability to learn. - Reliable internet and a professional working setup. ### Nice-to-haves: - Any prior web design experience (Custom work, Webflow, WordPress, Squarespace, Wix - any of them) - Any experience with terminal use on your Mac - Claude Code (your main tool) runs via terminal and all input is put into the terminal. - AI tool fluency. You have used ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, or similar for real work. - Australian or English-language brand familiarity. What I am specifically looking for: design judgement. Across every project. The thing that separates a good outcome from a mediocre one is whether the person doing the work can tell when something looks off and cares enough to fix it. That is the hire we need and will create a long-term ongoing position for. ## The work environment - Long-term role, not contract gig. We want someone for years. - Mostly async, with occasional Zoom calls. - I am in Melbourne, Australia (AEST). You work your normal Philippines hours (possibly starting slightly earlier than you might usually, at 8am if needed); we overlap several hours per day. - Weekly written check-ins, monthly reviews. - Performance-based rate increases. - We do not use Timeproof or tracking unless we feel your work output isn't meeting our metrics - Payment for the trial and trial period of 1-2 months will be via the OnlinePH jobs portal, ongoing payments if you are successfully hired will be via the Remote ( ---------- ) platform ## Compensation Initial rate will be between USD$4-$8 per hour, depending on qualifications, experience, portfolio and trial outcome. Rate will be reviewed twice annually with rate increases tied to performance. If you increase my business income with your good work, your rate will increase with it. ## How to apply There is a two-step process to apply. ### Step 1 - Initial application. Reply with: 1. Link to your portfolio. 2. One paragraph on why this role interests you specifically. 3. One paragraph on a recent design project you are proud of and why. 4. Confirmation you have a Mac. No cover letters please - the four items above are what I read. ### Step 2 - Paid trial brief (only if I shortlist your application). A two-part exercise: one graphic design task, one web design task. Approximately 5-7 hours of work, paid at the rate above, submitted within 3-4 days. I will respond to every applicant within 5 business days. Thanks - I looking forward to seeing your work and application. AJ

The immediate, day-to-day reality of this role will be: •  Writing SEO + GEO optimized content using Surfer SEO and Claude •  Adding that content to WordPress sites with full on-page SEO (URL, title, meta, H tags, schema, images, internal links) •  Manual citation and directory listing work •  Backlink outreach — finding prospects, sending personalized email s, tracking placements This is real, meaningful SEO work. We’re sharing the full picture now so you can see where this leads and whether it’s the kind of work you want to grow into. Technical SEO & On-Page - Conduct technical SEO audits and implement fixes across WordPress (Elementor) client sites - Optimize on-page elements across all existing and new content — URL structure, page title, SEO title, meta description, H tag hierarchy, image alt text and file naming, and internal link architecture - Schema markup implementation and validation - Site speed and Core Web Vitals monitoring and optimization Local SEO - Optimize and manage local SEO presence across Google Business Profile, Bing Places, and Apple Business Connect - Support entity and brand building — structured data, knowledge panels, brand mentions, and consistent NAP across the web Content Strategy - Help develop long-term content cluster strategies — mapping pillar pages, supporting spokes, and topical coverage gaps - Help plan and prioritize content roadmaps that build topical authority over time, not just individual rankings - Conduct ongoing competitor research — analyze competitor content strategies, topic coverage, keyword rankings, and SERP positioning - Apply Google’s E-E-A-T principles throughout content planning and production GEO / LLM Optimization - Implement and monitor GEO / LLM optimization strategies to improve visibility in AI-generated answers across Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Grok - Structure content deliberately for AI crawling and citation — clear headings, chunked answers, entity signals, and direct-answer formatting Data Analysis & Reporting - Monitor and analyze performance across Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools, Screaming Frog, GT Metrix, and Ahrefs - Run regular competitor SEO audits — track ranking movements, new content, backlink acquisition, and authority growth - Help diagnose traffic anomalies and ranking shifts with clear, evidence-backed explanations - Help pull together clear, consistent monthly client reports that connect SEO activity to real business outcomes - Monthly strategy collaboration with the SEO Director TOOLS YOU’LL WORK WITH Day-to-day proficiency with most of these tools is expected. We will train the right candidate on any gaps. - Search: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools - SEO Research: Ahrefs - Technical: Screaming Frog, GT Metrix - Local SEO: Google Business Profile, Bing Places, Apple Business Connect - Content & CMS: WordPress + Elementor, Surfer SEO - Project & Payroll: Teamwork (time tracking), Gusto (payroll) - AI & Productivity: Claude Cowork, Search Atlas QUALIFICATIONS Required - C2 English proficiency (Advanced/Mastery) — strong written English is essential for content creation and client-facing reports - 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience, ideally in an agency environment managing multiple client accounts - Proven ability to implement on-page and technical SEO — not just recommend it - Experience publishing content directly in WordPress including all on-page SEO tasks at time of publication - Strong writer who can produce clear, accurate, well-structured SEO content using AI tools like Claude efficiently without sacrificing quality - Comfortable with manual outreach work — prospecting, personalized email s, follow-up, and tracking - Comfortable with citation and directory work — detailed, methodical, and accurate - Strong analytical skills — you can find the signal in the data and explain what it means - Comfortable working independently with real accountability for client outcomes - Genuine curiosity about how search and AI-generated answers are evolving High-Value Skills (Not required, but candidates with experience in any of the following will stand out significantly) - Backlink building & outreach — campaign strategy, prospecting, and relationship-based link acquisition - Entity & brand building — structured data, knowledge panels, brand mention tracking, and consistent brand signals - GEO / LLM optimization — improving visibility in AI-generated answers (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Grok) - GEO-aware content structuring — deliberate chunking, entity signals, and direct-answer patterns that AI crawlers surface - Content cluster architecture — designing hub-and-spoke topical authority structures that compound in value over time Nice to Have - Familiarity with WordPress (Elementor) from an SEO perspective — not asking you to build sites, but understanding how they work helps - Experience with city/service landing page strategies and local search network builds - I'm a keynote speaker and executive coach advising C-suite executives at companies like L'Oréal, Mercedes-Benz, and Accenture on leadership and authority-building in the AI era. As the channel grows, so does the workload — and I'd rather promote someone who already knows the brand than hire a stranger. If you're excellent and committed, the path to a full-time role (and full-time pay) is real and explicitly planned for. If you've been burned before, here's what's different Most editors who apply to posts like this have the same story: a client who started strong, gave vague feedback, disappeared for weeks, then ended it with no warning. Or a creator who promised "long-term" and churned through three editors in a year because they never built a real workflow. I've built and run programs for C-suite executives. I know what structured feedback looks like. You'll get a detailed style guide before your first edit, written notes on every revision round, and a predictable content calendar so you can plan your week. The goal is not to find someone to fill a slot. It's to find someone worth promoting. If you're excellent, diligent, and done being treated like a vendor — this is the role. What you'll edit - Talking-head videos (10–15 min) with B-roll, lower thirds, and motion graphics — context cards on a black background are a core part of the visual style - Clean audio treatment: noise reduction, leveling, breath cuts - Color grading to match a consistent, refined look - Captions formatted to brand style: clean, minimal, sentence case - Short-form clips (60 sec) cut from the same raw footage for LinkedIn and Instagram What I'm looking for - Talking-head experience: your portfolio must include at least 2 full YouTube videos (10+ min) of talking-head or interview-style content edited for another creator. Self-edited content, travel videos, and gaming content do not qualify. - Motion graphics: you know how to use simple text-based context cards to anchor the viewer — not heavy animation, just clean and purposeful - Tool proficiency: Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve — tell me your version - Reliable internet: minimum 10 Mbps upload. Power backup for outages is a strong plus - Overlap hours: at least 2–3 hours between 9am–6pm CET daily - Strong communicator: clear English, complete sentences, proactive updates. How you write to me during the hiring process tells me how you'll work with me long-term. - Growth-minded: you want to build something, not fill a slot Not a fit if: your only long-form examples are self-edited or travel/lifestyle videos, you're currently upskilling toward talking-head editing, or you expect above $700/month for a part-time start. The hiring process 01 — You apply via the screening form below. Takes 10–15 minutes. No CV needed. 02 — Portfolio review — I look specifically at pacing on talking-head content, motion graphics quality, and audio treatment 03 — Paid test edit — 3–5 shortlisted candidates receive a raw clip with a brief and style reference. You'll be paid $25–$40. Deadline: 48 hours. 04 — Async Loom interview — 3–5 min video walking through your edit. No live call required. 05 — 30-day paid trial — structured month with clear deliverables, a style guide, and detailed feedback on every edit The trial month & path forward Month 1 — Paid trial $300–$350 flat. Deliverable: 4 videos to completion, max 2 revision rounds each. You receive a full style guide, reference videos, and written feedback on every edit. Months 2–3 — Active part-time contract $400–$550/month. 4–6 videos/month, 3–4 day turnaround from raw delivery. Predictable schedule, content calendar, clear revision policy. Month 4+ — Established rate & full-time opportunity Strong performers move to $600–$650/month part-time. title: Amazon Ads & Marketplace Growth Specialist
description: About the Role We are looking for an experienced Amazon Ads & Marketplace Growth Specialist to help manage, optimise and grow Amazon performance for consumer product brands. This role is suited to someone who understands Amazon as more than an advertising platform. We need someone who knows how Amazon works as a marketplace, sales channel, product testing environment, brand protection tool and retail growth accelerator. The right person will be confident working across Amazon Ads, Seller Central, Vendor Central, product listings, Amazon storefronts, Shopify connections, marketplace connectors, pricing control, product testing and campaign reporting. This is not a basic “set up campaigns and leave them running” role. We need someone who can think strategically, commercially and technically to help brands achieve profitable growth on Amazon. Role Overview You will help plan, launch, manage and optimise Amazon advertising campaigns while also supporting the marketplace strategy behind those campaigns. This includes understanding which products should be promoted on Amazon, how Amazon should work alongside Shopify or other eCommerce channels, how to avoid channel cannibalisation, and how to improve product visibility, pricing integrity and conversion performance. The ideal candidate will be able to look at an Amazon account and identify: Which campaigns are wasting spend Which products have the best growth potential Which listings need to be improved before scaling ads Whether Vendor Central, Seller Central or a hybrid model is best suited How Amazon can be used to test products before broader retail expansion What return is required before increasing the ad budget Key Responsibilities Amazon Advertising You will be responsible for planning, building, managing and optimising Amazon Ads campaigns, including: Sponsored Products Sponsored Brands Sponsored Brands Video Sponsored Display Keyword targeting campaigns Product targeting campaigns Defensive brand campaigns Competitor targeting campaigns Category campaigns Seasonal and promotional campaigns You will manage campaign structure, keyword strategy, bids, budgets, placement performance, search terms, product targeting and ongoing optimisation. Marketplace Strategy You will help shape Amazon growth strategies that support each brand’s wider sales and eCommerce model. This may include advising on: Amazon vs Shopify product separation Product testing strategies Channel segmentation Retail, Amazon and direct-to-consumer product allocation Seller Central vs Vendor Central suitability Hybrid marketplace models Marketplace connector setup Pricing and brand positioning Amazon’s role in future retail demand generation We need someone who can understand the commercial impact of Amazon, not just the advertising dashboard. Seller Central, Vendor Central & Hybrid Models The ideal candidate should have strong working knowledge of Amazon Seller Central and Vendor Central. You should understand the practical differences between: Selling directly to Amazon through Vendor Central Selling through Seller Central Using Seller Central for product testing and pricing control Using Vendor Central for established products Building a hybrid Amazon model Transitioning products from Shopify testing to Seller Central and then Vendor Central Using marketplace connectors to control listings, pricing and fulfilment Experience with Shopify-to-Amazon workflows, marketplace connectors or multi-channel listing tools will be highly valued. Product Listing & Marketplace Optimisation You will review and improve Amazon product listings to support stronger conversion rates and better campaign performance. This may include: Product titles Bullet points Product descriptions A+ Content Amazon storefront structure Product image recommendations Keyword optimisation Product positioning Review and rating considerations Listing consistency across marketplaces Product catalogue troubleshooting You should also be able to identify listing issues that may affect performance, including incorrect images, poor product data, weak product detail pages, incorrect brand links, duplicate listings, UPC/GTIN conflicts or storefront connection problems. Brand Protection & Pricing Integrity This role requires someone who understands the importance of brand control on Amazon. You may need to help identify and resolve issues such as: Amazon undercutting recommended pricing Product ranges damaging brand positioning Incorrect product information being pulled from other listings or marketplaces Distributors or third parties affecting catalogue control Products linking to the wrong storefront Inconsistent pricing across Amazon, Shopify and retail Poorly managed legacy SKUs affecting brand perception You should be comfortable making practical recommendations about whether products should be retained, removed, repositioned, relisted or shifted between Seller Central and Vendor Central. Product Testing & Campaign Scaling A key part of this role is helping brands test Amazon as a growth channel before scaling investment. You should be able to: Recommend which SKUs to test first Build a structured Amazon Ads testing plan Allocate initial campaign budgets effectively Track early performance clearly Identify winning products and campaigns Recommend when to scale spend Explain when a product is not ready for advertising Connect Amazon performance with broader eCommerce and retail goals You should be comfortable working with initial test budgets and proving whether Amazon can become a scalable channel. Reporting & Commercial Insights You will prepare clear, practical reporting that helps clients understand performance and make better decisions. Reporting may include: Spend Sales ACOS TACOS ROAS CPC CTR Conversion rate Keyword performance Search term performance Product-level performance Budget recommendations Listing improvement recommendations Next-step testing priorities Reports should be simple enough for management teams to understand, while still detailed enough to support proper campaign optimisation. Required Skills & Experience The ideal candidate will have proven hands-on experience in: Amazon Ads campaign management Amazon Seller Central Amazon Vendor Central Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display Amazon keyword research Product targeting and competitor targeting ACOS, TACOS, ROAS and conversion rate optimisation Product listing optimisation Amazon campaign reporting Marketplace strategy for consumer products Product launch or product testing campaigns Amazon storefronts and A+ Content Troubleshooting listing or catalogue issues Working with multiple SKUs and product ranges eCommerce performance marketing Highly Valued Experience Experience in any of the following would be a strong advantage: FMCG, grocery, beverage, food, health, wellness, lifestyle or premium consumer products Amazon Australia Brands selling through both Amazon and Shopify Marketplace connectors such as Codisto, Marketplace Connect or similar Shopify and Amazon integration Amazon Brand Registry UPC, GTIN or catalogue ownership issues Vendor Central pricing limitations Seller Central pricing control FBA, FBM and fulfilment workflows Seasonal campaigns, product launches and promotional campaigns Scaling Amazon campaigns from test budget to larger monthly spend Using Amazon to support wider retail demand or product validation Tools Experience Experience with any of the following tools would be useful: Amazon Ads Console Seller Central Vendor Central Amazon Brand Registry Amazon Brand Stores Shopify Marketplace Connect Codisto Helium 10 DataDive Scale Insights MerchantSpring Jungle Scout DataHawk Pacvue Perpetua Google Analytics Looker Studio Meta Ads reporting Google Ads reporting ChatGPT or Gemini for research and reporting workflows What Success Looks Like Success in this role means: Amazon campaigns are structured properly and actively optimised Ad spend is being used efficiently ACOS, TACOS, ROAS and profitability are advising on product and channel strategy Strong with numbers, testing and reporting Able to explain Amazon performance in plain English Confident working across ads, listings, pricing and marketplace setup Proactive in identifying issues and opportunities Experienced with consumer product brands Focused on profitable growth, not just traffic or impressions Application Requirements Please apply with your CV and a short summary of your Amazon experience. In your application, please include: Amazon marketplaces you have worked across Product categories you have managed Monthly ad budgets you have worked with Examples of ROAS, ACOS, TACOS or sales improvements Your experience with Seller Central Your experience with Vendor Central Any Shopify or marketplace connector experience Examples of listing, catalogue, Brand Registry or pricing issues you have helped resolve Experience with FMCG, beverage, grocery, food, wellness, health, lifestyle or premium consumer brands Tools you are confident using Suggested Job Title Amazon Ads & Marketplace Growth Specialist Alternative titles: Senior Amazon PPC Specialist Amazon Marketplace Specialist Amazon PPC & Seller Central Specialist Amazon Growth Strategist Amazon Performance Marketing Specialist Amazon Seller Central & Vendor Central Specialist Recommended title: Amazon Ads & Marketplace Growth Specialist How to Apply Please submit: your CV / resume a cover letter including: your current employment status your availability to start why you want to join the team why you believe you are a strong fit for this role your experience with Australian surveying workflows or companies, if applicable Before We Proceed Before we potentially proceed to the interview stage, we’d like to gather a few details to make sure the role is a good fit and that you’ll be set up for success working remotely with our team. 1) PC / Laptop specifications + internet speed Please share your device specs, including CPU, RAM, and storage, along with a recent internet speed test result. Our standard workdays are Monday to Friday, generally within 9:00am–5:00pm (Philippines time). We offer reasonable flexibility — family and life come first — but we do need consistency and clear communication. 5) Expected salary (PHP) If this differs from what was listed in the advert, please confirm your expected salary in PHP. 6) CV / Resume Please attach your CV if you haven’t already. 7) Relevant training / courses Please include any relevant training certificates or courses you’ve completed. 8) English level Please confirm your English level (C1/C2) and your confidence in both written and spoken English.
