title: Operations Manager — Dropshipping Fulfilment (3PL)
description: About the Role We run a 3PL fulfilment company shipping orders out of China for dropshippers and ecommerce brands worldwide. Our Chinese ops team handles the physical work — picking, packing, shipping. Our client base is growing and we've hit the point where the founder can no longer be the bottleneck in every decision. We need an Operations Manager to own the daily running of this company. That means: keep clients happy, keep the Chinese team accountable, keep the backend organized, and build the systems that let us scale to 3x our current client volume without things falling apart. Client Operations Be the senior point of contact across all client group chats — you don't handle every message, but nothing critical happens without your awareness Own client onboarding end-to-end: from signed agreement to first 100 orders shipped smoothly Step in personally on escalations, angry clients, and high-stakes problems Retain clients. Churn is your number. China Team Management Direct the 10-person Chinese ops team on daily priorities, exceptions, and quality issues Hold them accountable for SLAs: pick accuracy, ship times, error rates Translate between client expectations and ops reality — and fix the gap when it exists Run weekly ops syncs, identify bottlenecks, remove them Backend & Systems Audit our current backend (tools, SOPs, documentation, tracking) and identify what's broken Build the systems and processes we need to handle 3x volume without 3x headaches Document everything. If it lives only in someone's head, it doesn't exist. Choose and implement tools where needed (project management, client portal, internal comms) Performance & Reporting Define the KPIs that matter: on-time ship rate, error rate, client retention, response times Report weekly to the founder on what's working, what's broken, and what you're doing about it Surface problems early — bad news fast, good news whenever What You Need to Have 2+ years in operations, ideally within 3PL, fulfilment, or ecommerce/dropshipping Hands-on Shopify experience — order management, app integrations, troubleshooting fulfilment workflows. Non-negotiable. Experience managing or coordinating a team (size less important than proof you can hold people accountable) Direct experience coordinating with Chinese suppliers or operations teams Native or near-native English (written and verbal) Track record of building systems and SOPs — bring examples to the interview Comfortable with ambiguity and authority. You'll make decisions daily without asking permission. Calm operator. Dropshippers panic, suppliers make mistakes, you stay analytical. Strong Plus Mandarin or working Chinese — game-changer for ops team management Experience with ad-driven ecommerce — you understand why a delayed shipment during a viral product launch is a five-alarm fire Familiarity with tools like ClickUp, Notion, ShipStation, CJ Dropshipping, or similar Experience scaling a fulfilment or logistics operation from small to mid-size Who This Job Is NOT For Pure customer service managers who've never owned operations Logistics managers from large corporates looking for a quieter role — this is fast, lean, and hands-on People who need detailed instructions before acting Anyone allergic to direct feedback or fast decisions Looking forward to meet you!

title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description: I'm the founder of a digital growth marketing company that helps mission-driven founders scale their businesses with more ease & less overwhelm - and I'm looking for a small team of highly-skilled Executive Assistants to help take over the marketing and management tasks that make a huge difference in the lives of the people that hire us. I'm looking for a max of 5 amazing executive assistants available for part-time (potential for full time) with a salary starting at $500 USD per month and with long term success and robust training, moving up to $700 USD per month as an emerging leader in the company. If you have the following skill sets, I encourage you to apply: REQUIRED EXPERIENCE: - Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Digital Marketing, Video Editing, Social Media Management, Content Creation, and Executive Assistant Work (Administrative Tasks, Calendar & Email Management, etc) You’re trusted to manage marketing deliverables while providing high-level executive support, keeping priorities organized, systems moving, and leadership focused on growth instead of day-to-day execution. You've done it all from managing schedules to email & calendar management. You have a meticulous eye for detail where Prioritization and Organization are your love language -- 1+ years of experience in Sales Funnels and Shopify You're a professional who is passionate about helping changemakers simplify their lives by setting up systems that will allow them to operate their businesses with more ease and less overwhelm. You have experience with sales funnel and CRM software - 1+ years of experience advertising on platforms like Instagram, Facebook , Tik Tok, within a Marketing team consisting of Paid Acquisition, Organic Marketing, Customer Retention, & Product Marketing You're an emerging leader who has the potential to head a team in the future that will report directly to you. Having leadership experience is a MAJOR plus - Creating SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) You’ll ensure each business function has detailed documentation for repeatable and scalable growth if it isn't already place. If you see gaps, you take the initiative to fill them and produce results without anyone knowing there was an issue (yea, all that and a bag of chips :-) - Experience working at a digital/online product/platform: You’re familiar with online courses, digital products & platforms and popular tools in the business space ranging from landing page builders and email service providers to CRMs, and course hosting platforms aren’t foreign to you (We teach tools like Shopify, Convertkit, Kajabi, Teachable, Learnworlds, Calendly, etc) ABOUT YOU: - “You down with SOP? Yeah you know me!”—You’re an advocate for SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) to make our systems repeatable & scalable. - Your love language is processes & predictable, meteoric growth. We never question company progress towards the quarterly and yearly goals because you keep real-time metrics for all projects. - You’re aware of new software and can look at current systems and identify how to automate tasks a company has been doing manually for months. - You’re addicted to digital processes & automation in the world of social media because you love building connections in the digital space and you’ve seen how powerful it can be in business growth - You’re driven by metrics & tracking. You know that you can’t improve something unless you measure it, so you develop ways to measure performance so your company is always predictably improving. - Timeliness and deadlines are your jam. When we have a team call at 10:00am, you show up at 9:55am. When the deadline is Tuesday at 5:30pm, you have it done Monday. - You overcommunicate clearly and confidently. If you agree/disagree with something, you communicate that without hesitation or overthinking. You’re no stranger to asking why we do things a certain way to ensure we’re intentional with our resources. - You’re a leader and team player. Ego? What ego? If something needs to be done, you dive in to make sure all critical tasks are accounted and cared for. If you’re nodding your head “Yes” to the above, proceed below to apply. PERKS: I'm committed to setting our staff up for success with access to trainings that will certify your skills in: - Task & Calendar Management - Launch/Sales Strategy Planning - Sales Funnel Tech Setup (For E-Commerce or Service Based Businesses) - Social Media Management - Digital Media Marketing (Including Email and SMS Marketing) - Lead Generation After one week of training and assessment, you're officially certified under our internal training program, which means hitting the ground running with your new skills. Perks include: - Part time work hours - Work from anywhere in the world (as long as your internet signal is strong and computer is fast) - Starting Salary at $500 USD a month ($6000 USD annual) - Internal certification program to enhance your professional skills in your career (I have helped clients amass at least $10M from the same digital growth marketing strategies I will require you to learn) Interested? Please reply to this post with the secret keyword "APPLES" so I know you can pay attention to detail - from there, I'll let you know next steps if you qualify.

We are not a typical agency. We use AI — Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity — as core production tools, not novelties. We build structured frameworks and systems for SEO and GEO execution. We make decisions from data, not guesses. If you want to do real technical SEO work inside a team that's operating at the front edge of where search is going — keep reading. JOB OVERVIEW We're hiring a technical SEO specialist who can execute across three domains: 1) Technical SEO & Site Architecture (40%) — Conduct full technical audits, diagnose crawlability and indexation issues, resolve Core Web Vitals problems, optimize site architecture, and implement fixes across WordPress sites. You find what's broken, you explain why it matters, and you fix it or direct the fix with precision. 2) On-Page Optimization & Structured Data (30%) — Implement on-page SEO at the element level: title tags, meta descriptions, header hierarchy, internal linking architecture, image optimization, and schema markup. You own structured data — JSON-LD, entity relationships, knowledge graph signals. You don't just know what schema is; you can hand-write it, validate it, and deploy it. 3) SEO Reporting, Strategy & Client Deliverables (30%) — Build and maintain client-facing SEO reports. Track keyword rankings, organic traffic, Core Web Vitals, and conversion metrics. Prepare strategy documents and audit deliverables that leadership presents to clients. Your analysis is clear enough that someone else can walk a client through it without needing to ask you what you meant. This is not a content writing role. We have separate systems and tea ---------- mbers for article production. You will not be writing blog posts. If content production is your primary skill, this is not the right fit. This is not a client-facing role. Leadership handles all client communication. You will never be on a client call. Your work speaks through the deliverables you produce and the results you drive. WHO YOU ARE You're a technician. You find more satisfaction in a clean crawl report with zero errors than in a well-written paragraph. You think in systems. description: We run lead generation Google Ads campaigns for a marketing agency in the Netherlands. We need a freelancer to audit and fix conversion tracking for one client account. This role covers tracking implementation and debugging only, not campaign management, bidding, or audience strategy. How to apply Send a short message describing a conversion tracking issue you diagnosed and fixed before. Include the tools you used and what the root cause turned out to be. title: Senior Financial Controller (Xero) — Rebuild & Own the Finance Function of a Fast-Scaling E-commerce Brand
job_title: Senior Financial Controller (Xero) — Rebuild & Own the Finance Function of a Fast-Scaling E-commerce Brand
description: We're an Australian premium e-commerce retailer — pool tables, arcade machines, pinball, kegerators, saunas and more. We do $10M in revenue and we're scaling to $40M over the next two years. We run our own warehousing, national delivery and an installation team. We're ambitious, we move fast, and we are dead serious about fixing our finance function properly this time. We're looking for a Senior Financial Controller to take full ownership of our books, rebuild our Xero from the ground up, and turn it into the system the business actually steers by. This is a long-term, full-time, ongoing role. It is not a project, not a tidy-up, and not a part-time advisory seat. READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING — WE'RE BEING COMPLETELY STRAIGHT WITH YOU Our books are not in good shape, and we're not going to pretend otherwise. Xero is disconnected from our inventory system. Our cost of goods is inflated and nobody can fully explain why. Our chart of accounts can't show us profit by product category or by department. We've had two bookkeepers and two senior finance people through this business and the books are no better than a year ago. We have strong data sitting in our other systems — Shopify, Unleashed, Polar Analytics — but nothing ties together in Xero, and Xero is not currently a source of truth. We are telling you this upfront because we want someone who reads that and gets interested, not nervous. If untangling a genuine mess and building order out of it is the work you're best at and enjoy most, keep reading. If you want a clean set of books to gently maintain, this is the wrong role and we'll both know it quickly. WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY IS You will own the finance function. Not assist it — own it. In your first months the job is heavy reconstruction: you will pull apart what's wrong, rebuild the Xero chart of accounts properly, and rebuild trust in every number. Once it's clean, you run it — month-end, management accounts, cash flow, reporting — and you keep it immaculate. You'll work directly with the CEO and closely with our operations team, and you'll be the person who can answer, with confidence and evidence, “are we actually making money, and where?” WHAT YOU'LL DELIVER The headline outcomes we are hiring you to produce: - Xero rebuilt as the single source of truth — a clean, correctly structured chart of accounts the leadership team trusts without second-guessing. - Profit visibility by product category — pool tables, arcade, pinball, kegerators, dartboards, LED and furniture — so we finally know which categories make money and which don't. This is a build and depends on cost inputs being cleaned up over time; you'll be central to getting there. - Departmental P&L — cost-centre reporting so marketing, sales, operations and admin can each see and own their numbers. - Reliable month-end — a full close and management accounts the business can make real decisions on, every month, on time. - A 13-week rolling cash flow forecast — we have seasonal revenue and financing facilities; we need to see cash coming before it becomes a problem. WHAT YOU'LL OWN DAY TO DAY - Rebuilding and maintaining the Xero chart of accounts and tracking-code structure. - Untangling cost of goods — core stock vs drop-ship, freight-in vs freight-out, installation costs, merchant fees, and the inventory adjustment journals currently muddying the picture. - Owning the reconciliation of data flowing from Shopify and our inventory system (Unleashed) into Xero, with no unexplained variances. Our operations team owns the inventory system itself — you are the person who makes sure it reconciles cleanly into the books. - The full month-end close and management accounts. - The 13-week cash flow view and tracking of our financing facilities. - Bank reconciliation, accounts payable, supplier invoice processing and payment run preparation. - Feeding clean, reliable data to our external Australian tax accountant, who handles tax, GST and BAS. WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR - This is a senior role and we need a senior person. Specifically: - 6+ years in accounting or finance, with real depth in e-commerce, retail or inventory-heavy businesses. - Genuine Xero mastery — you have personally restructured a chart of accounts and built a tracking-code framework, not just worked inside one someone else set up. Xero certification expected or close to it. - A demonstrable track record of taking messy, untrusted books and making them clean and reliable — this is the single most important thing we're hiring for. - Strong command of inventory and cost-of-goods accounting — you understand how landed cost, stock and COGS move through the books. - Confident building cost-centre and category-level reporting from scratch. - Hands-on with Shopify and an inventory/ERP system (Unleashed or similar). - Self-directed and accountable — you own outcomes, surface problems early, and don't need chasing. - Excellent written and spoken English, and genuinely confident leading a conversation on a weekly video call with the CEO. - A reliable internet connection, a quiet space for video calls, and solid working overlap with Australian Eastern time (AEST). WHAT'S IN IT FOR THE RIGHT PERSON - Full ownership of a finance function from day one — this is your domain to build. - A genuine path to a senior finance leadership seat as we scale toward $40M; we want this person to grow with us. - A long-term, stable, full-time role with a business that's serious about getting this right and will back you to do it. - A proper handover and structured onboarding — you will not be dropped in cold. - Direct line to the CEO; your work will visibly drive how the business makes decisions. - Paid local Philippine public holidays and a genuine commitment to a long-term working relationship. HOW TO APPLY Applications must be submitted through our application form. Applications that come only as a message here, without the form completed, will not be reviewed. Apply here: ---------- We're interviewing immediately and moving quickly for the right person.

title: Sign Industry Estimator
description: **MUST BE AVAILABLE MONDAY THROUGH FRIDAY 8am-4pm MST Position Overview We are a custom sign manufacturing and installation company seeking an experienced Estimator to join our team remotely. In this role, you will read and interpret architectural and shop drawings, develop accurate cost estimates, and build winning bids for interior and exterior sign projects ranging from single-tenant signage to multi-location rollouts. You will work closely with sales, project managers, fabrication, and installation crews to ensure every estimate reflects true scope, true cost, and a margin we can stand behind. This is a fully remote position with regular collaboration via Microsoft Teams. The right candidate is detail-obsessed, deadline-driven, and comfortable owning the numbers from takeoff through bid handoff. Key Responsibilities • Read and interpret drawings: Review architectural plans, elevations, site plans, shop drawings, electrical drawings, and landlord/municipal sign criteria packages to define accurate scope. • Perform quantity takeoffs: Extract material types, square footage, linear footage, hardware counts, and electrical specs from drawings and RFP documents. • Build complete estimates: Price materials, fabrication labor, finishing, freight, permitting, engineering, installation labor, equipment (lifts, cranes, traffic control), and applicable markups. • Specify installation scope: Determine mounting methods, wall conditions, electrical requirements, lift or crane needs, permitting obligations, and crew sizing for both interior and exterior installs. • Source and quote vendors: Solicit and evaluate quotes from material suppliers, sub-fabricators, electrical sign manufacturers, permit runners, and installation subcontractors. • Maintain pricing data: Work with Purchasing to ensure material, labor, and burden rates are current • Produce bid documents: Deliver clean, client-ready proposals with clear scope, inclusions, exclusions, assumptions, lead times, and payment terms. • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work with sales on pursuit strategy, with production on buildability, and with project managers on smooth job handoff after award. • Track and analyze: Maintain a bid log, hit-rate tracking, and post-job cost reviews to continuously sharpen estimating accuracy. Required Qualifications • Sign industry experience: 3+ years estimating in custom signage (channel letters, monuments, pylons, wayfinding, ADA, dimensional, vinyl/graphics, and electrical signage). • Drawing literacy: Demonstrated ability to read architectural drawings, shop drawings, electrical schematics, and sign criteria packages without hand-holding. • Pricing fluency: Strong working knowledge of sign materials (aluminum, acrylic, LEDs, power supplies, vinyl, hardware), fabrication processes, finishes, and labor burden. • Installation knowledge: Practical understanding of interior and exterior install methods, wall types, mounting hardware, electrical hookup, lifts, cranes, and permitting workflows. • Excel proficiency: Comfortable with formulas, lookups (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH), pivot tables, and conditional logic; able to build and maintain estimating workbooks. • ERP software: Hands-on experience with an ERP or job costing system (e.g., CYRIOUS Control, Shopify Sign, NetSuite, Sage, or similar). Must be able to enter and pull data confidently. • Microsoft Teams: Comfortable working remotely through Teams for meetings, chat, file collaboration, and channel-based project communication. • Communication: Clear written communication for proposals, scope clarifications, and vendor follow-ups; comfortable on video calls with internal teams and clients. • Work environment: Reliable remote workspace, dedicated workstation with dual monitors recommended, and stable high-speed internet. Preferred Qualifications • Experience in estimating national rollouts or multi-site programs. • Familiarity with UL listing requirements for electric signs. • Working knowledge of local permitting processes and landlord criteria packages. • Bluebeam, AutoCAD, or other PDF/CAD markup experience. • Background in fabrication, project management, or field installation before moving into estimating. What Success Looks Like in This Role • Estimates are accurate, complete, and submitted on or before deadline. • Bid hit rate improves quarter-over-quarter without margin erosion. • Post-job cost variance stays within target on awarded work. • Sales, production, and installation teams trust the numbers and the scope handoff. Submit your resume along with a brief note describing: (1) the largest or most complex sign project you have estimated, (2) the ERP system you have used most, and (3) your approach to estimating an exterior illuminated channel letter set on an unfamiliar building. Strong candidates will be invited to a working session that includes a sample takeoff.
